notes.title: [Notice] 09/24 Item Reclamation and Follow-up Measures
notes.content:
[p][/p][p align="start"]Hello, Stalkers, 
This is the Dungeon Stalkers Ops Team.[/p][p align="start"]We are providing information regarding the account sanctions and item reclamation measures that occurred on September 24.
[/p][p align="start"][b]\[Background of Account Sanctions][/b] 
It was confirmed that an exploit existed where dropping stackable items with a quantity of 0 inside the dungeon would allow their quantity to be increased. This was an issue that should not have occurred under normal circumstances, and the development team takes full responsibility.[/p][p align="start"]Accordingly, we conducted a full investigation of accounts possessing a certain quantity or more of Selectors or Consumables. While some legitimate users may have been included in this reclamation, the sanctions and reclamation were unavoidably carried out.[/p][p align="start"]This measure was promptly decided because if illicitly increased items flowed into the Market, it could significantly impact the game's economy.[/p][p align="start"]Although items acquired through legitimate means were planned to be distributed later, due to the urgent situation, prior notice was insufficient. We deeply apologize for not being able to provide sufficient explanation beforehand.
[/p][p align="start"][b]\[Reclamation Status][/b] 
Accounts for which reclamation has been completed have had their restrictions lifted, while accounts with severe exploitation were permanently banned.
[/p][p align="start"]Permanently Banned Accounts due to Exploitation:[/p][p align="start"][b]日〇〇〇[/b]
[/p][p align="start"][b]\[Current Status and Information][/b] 
If items were reclaimed despite being acquired through legitimate means, the development and operations teams are preparing for their recovery.[/p][p]They will be distributed to your in-game mailbox as soon as the process is complete.
[/p][p align="start"]We extend our deepest apologies to all Stalkers who love Dungeon Stalkers, and we promise to do our utmost to prevent recurrence and provide fair and stable service in the future.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Thank you. Sincerely, The Dungeon Stalkers Ops Team[/p]

notes.title: [Notice] Teaming Sanction Announcement
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Stalkers![/p][p]This is the Dungeon Stalkers Operations Team.[/p][p] [/p][p]We have recently identified instances of teaming activities among some Stalkers.
This severely undermines a fair game environment and will not be tolerated under any circumstances.[/p][list][*][p]Upon first detection of teaming, a 1-day access restriction will be applied.[/p][/*][*][p]For subsequent detections, [b]a permanent access restriction may be immediately applied, regardless of the number of offenses, depending on the category of exploitative behavior.[/b][/p][/*][*][p]Operational policies can be immediately strengthened and applied at the discretion of the Operations Team based on severity, and even for the first sanction, a permanent restriction may be applied immediately depending on the circumstances. 
[/p][/*][/list][p]Therefore, no excuses will be accepted for teaming activities, and the Operations Team will impose firm and strong sanctions.[/p][p]Furthermore, if you discover suspicious teaming situations during gameplay, we kindly request active reporting, including video evidence.[/p][p]Your cooperation is a great strength in maintaining a healthy game culture.[/p][p]Thank you.[/p][p]Sincerely,
Dungeon Stalkers Operations Team[/p]

notes.title: Dungeon Stalkers 1.4 Update Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]Hello Stalkers,[/p][p]The 1.4 update brings a host of new content and system improvements designed to add new depth to your adventures. Test your limits against a new dungeon and powerful boss, and perfect your strategy with a complete balance overhaul and new Legendary gear.[/p][p]Based on your valuable feedback, we've also enhanced combat, improved convenience features like the dungeon reconnect system and secure bag save functionality, and, as you've been eagerly awaiting, added controller support to make your Dungeon Stalkers gameplay even smoother. We’ve also included a variety of bug fixes.[/p][p]Here are the detailed notes for the update our dev team has worked so hard on.[/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]Key Update Highlights[/b][/h2][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Dungeon 'The Catacombs':[/b] A new area filled with fresh threats and rewards awaits.[/p][/*][*][p][b]The Return of the Lord 'Forgotten King':[/b] Challenge the raid boss, 'Forgotten King', who has returned more powerful than ever.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Stalker Balance Adjustments:[/b] All Stalkers' skills and stats have been rebalanced to provide a new combat experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New Legendary Gear Added:[/b] We’ve added new Legendary gear with powerful effects, offering a wider range of equipment choices. Some of these new Legendary items cannot be crafted and can only be obtained in dungeons.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Core System Additions & Improvements:[/b] Systems like Killcam, Solo Ranking, and a reconnect feature have been added and improved for a more enjoyable and fair gameplay experience.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Controller Support:[/b] Controller support has been added for dungeon gameplay.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h2][b]I. In-Game Play[/b][/h2][p][/p][h3][b]1. Combat System[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Logic Improvements & Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Improved the accuracy of attack hitboxes for more precise strikes.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue with some arrow attacks firing at an abnormally high speed.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved logic to allow large monsters to pass through destroyed doors naturally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where players could abnormally attack through walls.[/p][/*][*][p]Refined the anti-hacking logic to improve accuracy and fix cases where some projectiles' hit detection was ignored.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where an extra arrow was fired when using certain skills under specific conditions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the 'Heart Chaser' Legendary gear's arrows consuming ammo and attaching to the character's body.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where shooting near a 'Torch' object would not deal damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a rare issue where the game would freeze when taking damage from the magnetic field.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed unintended behaviors of some boss monsters, such as 'The Butcher' boss's attacks not dealing damage.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some Legendary gear effects were applied unintentionally.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an error where other players' rune information was displayed incorrectly during spectating.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]2. Stalkers: Balance Adjustments[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]All Stalkers[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the stamina cost of blocking to be more efficient than before.[/p][list][*][p]Melee Attack Block Cost: 30 → 27[/p][/*][*][p]Ranged Projectile Block Cost: 40 → 32[/p][/*][*][p]Magic Attack Block Cost: 50 → 35[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]The maximum duration of the Stun status effect has been lowered to 2 seconds.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the ultimate skill requirements for each Stalker's unique traits. [/p][list][*][p]We analyzed combat data during the Early Access period and adjusted the requirements for Stalkers with an excessively high or low ultimate skill dependency, making them more accessible overall.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p]All healing skills now have their healing amounts increased based on the caster's Magic Damage and Intelligence stats.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Baran[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Grappling Hook:[/b] Mana Cost 12 → 14[/p][/*][*][p][b]Deep Stab:[/b] Cooldown 6s → 7s, Mana Cost 7 → 10[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Hilda[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Blade Clash:[/b] Cooldown 5s → 6s, Mana Cost 9 → 11[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Nave[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Liberation Rune:[/b] Movement Speed during cast 100% → 80%[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Lian[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Downpour Rune:[/b] Duration 20s → 15s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Rapid Fire:[/b] Damage 100% → 85%, Mana Cost 13 → 16[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Urud[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Explosive Rune:[/b] Duration 20s → 15s[/p][/*][*][p][b]Multi-Shot:[/b] Cooldown 6s → 7s, Mana Cost 11 → 14[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Shinobu[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Lightning Flash:[/b] Cooldown 6s → 8s, Mana Cost 8 → 11[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Clad[/b][/p][list][*][p]Magic Damage of Bludgeon weapons has been increased to align with the new healing formula.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][i]Based on an analysis of combat logs, the value of skills that cause 'Stagger' has proven to be much higher than expected as Stalkers' proficiency increased. We have made adjustments to all skills that cause stagger to balance this. Furthermore, Rien and Urd's damage contribution in team fights and PvE scenarios was unexpectedly high, so we have made slight adjustments to their sustained damage output.[/i][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]3. Stalkers: Bug Fixes & Improvements[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Rio:[/b] Fixed an issue where damage was not applied when chaining a specific skill after a basic attack, and where right-click attack stacks were not accumulating. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Baran:[/b] Fixed an issue where opponents hit by the 'Grappling Chain' skill would float unnaturally and an issue where the skill would not activate in certain situations. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Clad:[/b] Fixed an issue where he would take abnormal damage from traps during 'Prayer of Healing' and an issue where the healing amount was not applied as intended. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Lian:[/b] Reworked the 'Lotus Blossom' skill logic for more stable performance. [b]Shinobu:[/b] Improved the explosion hitbox of the 'Blast Tag' skill to function as intended. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Urud:[/b] Fixed an issue allowing characters to walk on top of the 'Steel Trap'. [/p][/*][*][p][b]Hilda:[/b] Improved the 'Shield Block' animation for a smoother transition. Fixed an issue where the 'Counter' skill would not deal damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Monsters[/b] [b]Balance Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]Increased the time it takes for boss monsters to finalize their attack direction. They will now track their target for a longer period before attacking.[/p][/*][*][p]The elemental resistance values of bosses have been changed.[/p][/*][*][p]Golden Mimics can now appear in locked chests.[/p][/*][*][p]The Ghost's blood-spitting attack will now track Stalkers more effectively.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some of 'The Butcher's' attacks failed to damage Stalkers.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some of the Ghost's resistance values were set incorrectly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Ghost was being caught in Urd's traps. (Ghosts don't have feet!)[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]4. New Content & Systems[/b][/h3][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Dungeon: The Catacombs[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new map, 'The Catacombs', featuring a new layout and new monsters has been added.[/p][/*][*][p]The Catacombs map is available in all game modes.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Map Structure[/b][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/3233925fd8a2726d46c223d35e1cbc7e0f291995.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p]In a specific area of The Catacombs map, you can encounter the 'Forgotten King' field boss.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/e81ef131d45fc94e3db946d9088749e3040b5558.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Dungeon Reconnect System[/b][/p][list][*][p]A system has been added to allow you to reconnect if you are disconnected due to a client crash or network instability during a dungeon run.[/p][/*][*][p]If your Stalker is still alive in the dungeon, you can relaunch the game to see a pop-up. If you choose to reconnect, you can continue playing with that Stalker.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/fcc250c3b3a809b5adc2d894f0dfb91e0159504f.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p]If you choose not to reconnect, you will not be able to do so later, and your Stalker will be considered dead.[/p][/*][*][p]You cannot reconnect if your Stalker dies or the dungeon ends while you are disconnected.[/p][/*][*][p]A disconnected Stalker will die instantly without entering a downed state.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Secure Bag Save Frequency Shortened[/b][/p][list][*][p]The secure bag now saves more frequently to your player database to prevent item loss during abnormal crashes.[/p][/*][*][p]If you're worried about losing valuable items from a dungeon run, we encourage you to use the secure bag.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Magnetic Field Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]The damage from the magnetic field has been adjusted based on its stage.[/p][/*][*][p]Damage taken will increase as the phases progress.[/p][/*][*][p]The related UI will not be displayed in game modes without a magnetic field.
[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Witch's Curses[/b][/p][list][*][p]Three new curses with unique effects have been added.[/p][/*][*][p]The effect of the 'Increased Skill Mana Cost' curse has been buffed from 15% → 50%.[/p][/*][*][p]New Witch's Curses[/p][list][*][p][b]Fatigue Recovery[/b] : Stamina recovery rate is increased until the next Witch's Curse.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Time of Evolution[/b] : One stat (STR, DEX, INT, CON, WIS) is randomly increased or decreased upon defeating a monster or player.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Unstable Power[/b] : All of your damage deals an additional -30% to +50% damage. |[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Gamepad Support Added: Dungeon Play[/b][/p][list][*][p]Controller support has been added for dungeon gameplay.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Please disable 'Enable Steam Input' in Steam's controller settings.
[/b][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/28131349802bd46552cce85b8a7482dd00c93c23.png"][/img][/p][/*][*][p]If you are using Steam Input, please follow these steps to disable it:[/p][list][*][p]Exit the game → From the Dungeon Stalkers page in your Steam Library, click on the [b]Controller Settings[/b] button → Select [b]Disable Steam Input[/b]

notes.title: Developer's Note - September Update Preview
notes.content:
[p]Hello Stalkers! [/p][p]This is SJGO, Head of Development for Dungeon Stalkers.[/p][p align="start"]Today, we'd like to share the details of our first Pre-Season update, scheduled for next week. [/p][p align="start"]We have prepared a variety of new content and in-game improvements, so please refer to the details below.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]■ New Dungeons & Content[/b][/h3][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]New Dungeon: Catacombs[/b][/p][list][*][p]The new map, 'Catacombs,' will be introduced in this update!
In this newly added dungeon area, theme-appropriate monsters will constantly be on the lookout for Stalkers.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/5df5fdac4546747e740424adf697aad8d77e492d.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/f23f9b4b70982124f85aeb309e7d0099b88fb54e.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/9445081e1c214d3237a8fdeb09e8db552438a98b.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/1e11b3b7b1b001d129026536b2e89eff8ac8cb27.png"][/img][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/8da2cc5962ff43d5b380c2a701f372935f333234.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]New Raid Boss: Forgotten King[/b][/p][list][*][p]'The Forgotten King' has returned!
After this update, in a hidden tomb within the Catacombs, you will once again face 'The Forgotten King'.
Defeating the Forgotten King will give you a high chance of obtaining powerful items.
[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/59739154f7387aae7c9b4a23efe46e2afc429ed1.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]Raid Boss Battle Rewards Enhanced[/b][/p][list][*][p]The rewards obtainable from defeating raid bosses and within the boss dungeons will be enhanced!
We are preparing better rewards to make conquering boss dungeons more worthwhile, but don't forget that you'll be competing not only with the boss monster but also with all the other Stalkers aiming for the treasure.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]New Legendary Equipment & Blueprints Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Legendary equipment will be added to bring more strategic diversity.
Legendary equipment modifies the unique skills of Stalkers, allowing for more diverse strategic gameplay different from the existing meta, depending on your loadout.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/64c29bf48da43aeb89a6deedd3269b0abed26566.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]Leaderboard Revamp: Competitive (Solo) Leaderboard and Other Common Rankings Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new leaderboard for Competitive (Solo) will be added.
The 'Escape Artist' (number of dungeon escapes) and 'The Gladiator' (number of player kills) rankings will be added, similar to the Competitive (Trio) mode, and a new boss kill ranking will be added for each mode.
In addition to the existing 'The Richest' (gold ranking) leaderboard, two new rankings will be added separately.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/7b3a49c34bfa7a893533cc3675ed35fe81a0acb1.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][list][*][p][b]New Witch's Curses Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Several new Witch's Curses that can change the tide of the game will be added.[/p][p]Please look forward to the patch notes after the update for detailed information on what synergies they create with existing curses and what new variables they bring to the game.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]Costumes Purchasable with Adventure Coins Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]In-game costumes that can be purchased with Adventure Coins will be added.[/p][p]This will allow you to purchase some costumes using Adventure Coins acquired from the dungeon.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/ea12fb8442a35243797a5ca19afaffc428415137.gif"][/img][/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][p][/p][/*][*][p][b]New Rare Themed Costumes Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]Nine new Rare Maid and Butler-themed costumes will be added.[/p][p]Themed costumes will continue to be released in various series in the future.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/7062bfe72fb144a5d9fb8fa29dd8392e7bd5f841.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Game System Improvements[/b][/h3][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]Reconnect System Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]We will be introducing a system that allows you to re-enter a dungeon if you experience an unexpected game crash.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]Safe Pouch Functionality Enhanced[/b][/p][list][*][p]The contents of the Safe Pouch will be synchronized with the server in real-time to ensure that your items are kept up-to-date even in the event of an abnormal client shutdown or server crash.[/p][p] [/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]■ Quality of Life Improvements[/b][/h3][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]Kill Cam Improved[/b][/p][list][*][p]After dying in a dungeon, players will now have the option to choose whether or not to view the kill cam.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/9fa74393822e1ebe216f7d39dc4d488a43eab295.gif"][/img][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"][/p][list][*][p][b]Monster Color Adjustments[/b][/p][list][*][p]The colors of some monsters will be changed to improve their visibility within the dungeon.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]Gamepad Support Added[/b][/p][list][*][p]We will be adding gamepad (controller) support for in-game dungeon play.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]More detailed update information will be provided in the upcoming patch notes. Our Dungeon Stalkers team will continue to work tirelessly to provide high-quality content, meet the expectations of our Stalkers, and ensure a stable gaming experience.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]We hope you will continue to watch over and support Dungeon Stalkers.[/p][p align="start"]See you again in the dungeon.[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Developer's Note #3-1
notes.content: [p align="start"]Hello, this is SJGO, the head of development for [b]Dungeon Stalkers.[/b][/p][p align="start"]After we announced the season reset in the last developer's note, many of you [b]Stalkers[/b] have expressed your concerns and disappointment. We sincerely apologize for the lack of information we shared, which has caused unnecessary misunderstanding and anxiety. We are taking every one of your voices to heart and would like to explain in more detail the direction of the season reset and what we are preparing.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]■ Your Efforts Will Absolutely Not Be Lost[/b][/h3][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]After listening to your diverse opinions and carefully reviewing them internally, we have decided to exclude [b]Hideout ‘Build’[/b] progress from the season reset.[/p][list][*][p][b]Excluded from Reset: Hideout ‘Build’ Progress[/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Through this decision, we want to show you that we are listening and that we never take your feedback lightly.[/p][p align="start"]Other than this, major currencies like Gold and Coins, as well as progress such as Stalker levels and owned equipment, will be reset as planned. However, this too never means that all the effort and time you Stalkers have invested during the past season will disappear.[/p][p align="start"]We plan to introduce a new point system that reflects all your gameplay achievements from the previous season. Through this system, you will be given what we're tentatively calling [b]‘Honor Points’[/b] at the start of the new season, ensuring that all your accomplishments and activities from the last season serve as a strong foundation for your journey in the new one.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]■ 'Honor Points' (Tentative Name) to Start the New Season With[/b][/h3][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]As this system is still under development, it is difficult to disclose the detailed specifications today. However, we promise to share the detailed plan before the season reset.[/p][p align="start"]Here are the details that have been confirmed so far:[/p][list][*][p][b]When it will be granted:[/b] At the start of the new season[/p][/*][*][p][b]Contributing factors for calculation:[/b] Various progression data from the previous season, such as [b]Stalker[/b] level, acquired Adventure Coins, and Gold[/p][/*][*][p][b]Example of use:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Permanent rewards like character appearances/emotes that can only be obtained with these points[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Expected effect:[/b] Designed so that those who fully enjoyed the previous season can earn corresponding honorable rewards[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We will continue to refine the system to ensure it provides fitting rewards for those who passionately played the last season and offers meaningful motivation for those aiming for greater heights in the new season.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]■ We Aim to Provide More Fun Through the Seasonal System[/b][/h3][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]We would also like to explain why we have chosen a seasonal system and season resets.[/p][p align="start"]Our goal is to provide new fun, metas, and strategic experiences with each season. If we carry over all progress from the previous season, the game's freshness and fairness would quickly diminish due to economic inflation, a solidified meta, and widening gaps between players. Our long-term internal tests also confirmed that a continuous progression structure accelerated boredom and increased stress.[/p][p align="start"]For this reason, we have been developing the game based on the premise of a seasonal system, considering the reset of some stats and progression. Instead, we intend to convert the previous season's achievements into points, returning them as tangible rewards and benefits that ease the early-game experience.[/p][p align="start"]We believe that the seasonal system is the best way for everyone to continue their challenge in the dungeons from a new starting line, exploring new strategies and tactics.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]■ We Will Work with You, Not Make Unilateral Declarations[/b][/h3][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]We want to emphasize that it is not our intention to unilaterally push the system we have designed or demand that you "just follow it." Although we are a small team, we chose the seasonal system to provide better and longer-lasting fun, and we will actively fix any problems that arise with each new season.[/p][list][*][p]Starting with the design of Season 1, we are refining the Honor Point system and reward structure to reflect your current concerns as much as possible.[/p][/*][*][p]If more development is needed to compensate for the weaknesses of the seasonal system, our development team will put in the necessary time to make it happen.[/p][/*][*][p]We will reverse wrong decisions and correct areas that need adjustment through updates.[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]For now, we kindly ask you to trust and wait just a little longer for the blueprint of Season 1 that we are preparing. After you experience it for yourselves, we will listen to your further suggestions and sharp criticisms and repay you with a better game.[/p][p align="start"]We are always listening to the voices of the community. We clearly understand the value of the time and effort you have invested, and we will design our systems in a way that respects that value.[/p][p align="start"]Once again, we apologize for the confusion caused by our previously insufficient guidance.[/p][p align="start"]We believe the best approach going forward is to show you through updates, and to continuously listen to your opinions and make adjustments throughout the process. We would be grateful if you could watch over us for just a little longer.[/p][p align="start"]The development team is currently preparing for the September update and the season update simultaneously, and we will be back with more specific details as soon as possible.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you.[/p][p align="start"]Sincerely, SJGO[/p]

notes.title: Early Access Developer's Note #3
notes.content: [p]Hello. This is SJGO, the head of development for Dungeon Stalkers.[/p][p align="start"]We are now in the third week of our Early Access launch.[/p][p align="start"]I want to express my sincere gratitude for the incredible amount of diverse feedback you've given us, far more than during any of our previous playtests.[/p][p align="start"]Our entire development team, including myself, treasures every single piece of your feedback and we are striving to implement it to make the game more stable and enjoyable.[/p][p align="start"]First, I'd like to address some of the topics you've been most curious about in this developer's note.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]■ Response to Hackers and Unauthorized Software Users[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Since launch, we have been dedicating our utmost efforts to blocking unauthorized software and penalizing its users. I'd like to take this opportunity to sincerely thank all the Stalkers who have actively reported users of unauthorized software.[/p][p align="start"]We have been analyzing various hacking methods directly, continuously adding corresponding counter-code, and strengthening our monitoring policies. We now believe that most hack usage is being systematically detected. However, as hackers will continue to find new ways to evade detection, we plan to enhance our logging systems and other measures accordingly. Let me be clear: regardless of the reason, using hack programs will result in penalties, including permanent bans, and we will show no leniency in this matter.[/p][h3][b]■ Regarding Content Updates[/b][/h3][p align="start"]While a more detailed update note will be provided later, I'd like to share some information in advance for those who are curious. We plan to release a variety of new content and systems in a regular content update scheduled for early to mid-September.[/p][list][*][p][b]Addition of a New Dungeon Theme[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new region will welcome you with more diverse treasures and powerful enemies.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/c26519afbc439a9d37d292e02c3542f041a94ad4.png"][/img][/p][list][*][p][b]Addition of New Legendary Items[/b][/p][list][*][p]New Legendary items and Blueprints will be added.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Addition of Skins Purchasable with Adventure Coins[/b][/p][list][*][p]As requested by many Stalkers , we have decided to add skins that can be purchased with Adventure Coins.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Enhancement of the Secure Inventory and Addition of a Dungeon Reconnect System[/b][/p][list][*][p]We are planning to improve the issue where items in the Secure inventory are not being saved due to server instability. Additionally, we will be adding the highly requested dungeon reconnect feature.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Matchmaking System Improvements to Help New Players Adapt[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Skill Balance Adjustments for Some Stalkers[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]Addition of a Leaderboard for Competitive (Solo) Mode[/b][/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]We are preparing a wide range of content, so please look forward to it.[/p][h3][b]■ Regarding the Season Reset[/b][/h3][p align="start"]Dungeon Stalkers will operate on a seasonal basis, and the Pre-Season is scheduled to end on [b]October 15, 2025[/b].[/p][p align="start"]Please note that the following will be reset at the start of the new season:[/p][list][*][p]All play records[/p][/*][*][p]Currency: Held Gold and Adventure Coins[/p][/*][*][p]Held Items: All items equipped by Stalkers , in the Inventory , Secure inventory, Storage, and listed on the Market[/p][/*][*][p]Construction: All Hideout construction elements and progress[/p][/*][*][p]Stalkers : Each Stalker's level and owned Runes[/p][/*][*][p]Season Pass : Season Pass progress and Quest status[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]The following will [b]not[/b] be reset:[/p][list][*][p]Prime Account Upgrade, Membership, and the duration of utility items[/p][/*][*][p]Held Wishstones and all items purchased from the Store[/p][/*][*][p]Owned Appearances (Skins) and Emotes[/p][/*][*][p]Owned Stalkers[/p][/*][*][p]Owned Blueprints[/p][/*][/list][p align="start"]Please also be aware that the new season update will include even more diverse content, such as new Stalkers and new game modes.[/p][p][/p][p align="start"]Once again, I would like to express my sincere gratitude to all the Stalkers who support Dungeon Stalkers. Although the game still has much room for improvement, our entire development team will continue to listen to your feedback and work tirelessly to make it a more enjoyable and stable experience.[/p][p align="start"]Below is a small gift from the development team.[/p][list][*][p]Redeem Code: DEVGIFT2508[/p][/*][*][p]Gift Contents[/p][list][*][p]10,000 Gold[/p][/*][*][p]100 Adventure Coins[/p][/*][*][p]1 Rare Weapon Selector Box[/p][/*][*][p]1 Rare Accessory Selector Box[/p][/*][*][p]3 Scroll Selector Boxes[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]Thank you.[/p]

notes.content: [p][b]\[Anti-Cheat & Anti-Fraud System Enhancements][/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Our development team's top priority is to create a clean and fair gaming environment for all Stalkers. In this update, we have added and improved our anti-fraud systems as follows.[/p][list][*][p][b]Added defense against item looting cheats[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new defense code has been implemented to prevent fraudulent activities related to item looting.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Refined cheat detection system[/b][/p][list][*][p]We have improved the existing defense codes and added/enhanced the system to respond to new unauthorized programs and fraudulent activities.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"]All fraudulent activities are immediately recorded by the system. Based on these records, we will apply sanctions in batches as quickly as possible. We will continue to eradicate the use of fraudulent activities through constant monitoring and response.[/p][p align="start"] [/p][p][b]\[Key Bug Fixes][/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]Crafting[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some items could not be crafted from the 'Witch's Cult Apostle' merchant.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where, in certain lobby and could not rejoin the party.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]System[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the item list in the Marketplace was not updating correctly.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where some 'Witch's Curse' effects were not being applied to characters.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where a Stalker not in the same party could execute a downed ally in Co-op PVE Mode.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][b]\[New Features & Improvements][/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]Matchmaking for Beginners[/b][/p][list][*][p]A safeguard has been added to match beginners with each other in Adventure Mode (PVE).[/p][/*][*][p]The weighting applied to equipment scores in matchmaking across all game modes has been adjusted.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Improved Item Discard UI[/b][/p][list][*][p]To clearly distinguish between the 'Split' and 'Discard' pop-up windows, a separate notification text will now be restrictions.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][p][b]\[Combat Improvements][/b][/p][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]Shinobi[/b][/p][list][*][p]Adjusted the hitboxes for Hiraikaku and Kibakufuda to fix an error where their hits were being nullified by the floor or walls.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p align="start"]The development team always considers it a crucial goal to create an environment where players of all skills and experience levels can enjoy the game.[/p][p align="start"]One of our biggest challenges is to help Stalkers who are just starting out to naturally experience the early game in a less competitive environment in Co-op Mode (PVE). We hope that this improvement will allow new users to experience and accumulate small achievements and fun, naturally adapting to the game.[/p][p align="start"]This is because the direction our development team is pursuing is not just a system that divides the user's experience into victory and defeat, but one that supports the entire journey of growing as an adventurer in this world against the threats of the dungeon. Ultimately, we aim to help you build upon these experiences, gradually advance to higher competitive tiers, and showcase your skills alongside various allies and enemies.[/p][p align="start"]The development team will continue to contemplate and improve the system to make it enjoyable for Stalkers at all levels.[/p][p align="start"]Thank you.[/p]

notes.title: August 19th Patch Notes
notes.content:
[p]In this update, we have focused on creating a more pleasant and fair gaming environment. We have strengthened our response to unauthorized programs (cheats) and adjusted the entry requirements for Ranked Matches to ensure more serious and competitive gameplay.[/p][p align="start"]You can find the detailed update notes below.[/p][hr][/hr][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]Updates for a Fair and Pleasant Gaming Environment[/b][/h3][p align="start"] [/p][p align="start"]Our development team is fully aware of how much unfair play using unauthorized programs can harm the enjoyment of the game. To ensure that all Stalkers can enjoy fair competition based on their skills and efforts, we have implemented the following measures:[/p][list][*][p][b]Implementation of Stronger Anti-Cheat Defense Code[/b][/p][list][*][p]A new defense code has been applied to the game to counter the use of unauthorized programs.[/p][/*][*][p]We will continue to protect a clean gaming environment through constant monitoring and swift responses.[/p][/*][/list][/*][*][p][b]Changes to Ranked Match Entry Requirements[/b][/p][list][*][p]The entry requirements for Ranked Matches have been partially changed to prevent users of unauthorized programs from easily accessing them.[/p][/*][*][p]From now on, new Stalkers can enter Ranked Matches 20 hours after their account is created.[/p][/*][*][p]This is a foundational measure to ensure all players can compete on a level playing field, and we promise to continue making improvements as needed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p align="start"] [/p][h3][b]System and Convenience Improvements[/b][/h3][p align="start"] [/p][list][*][p][b]Server Stabilization:[/b] 
We have reinforced our systems to address intermittent server crashes, 
allowing for more stable gameplay.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Drops Item Restoration:[/b] 
A feature has been added to restore items obtained through sources like Twitch Drops that were not correctly distributed in-game.
[/p][/*][*][p][b]Sanction Notification Pop-up Added:[/b]

notes.title: Dungeon Stalkers Early Access Dev Note #1
notes.content: [p]Hello, this is SJGO, the Head of Development for Dungeon Stalkers. [/p][p]I want to express my sincere gratitude to all the players who have shown such an enthusiastic response and provided a great deal of feedback on the first day of our Early Access. As we have promised, we are committed to listening to your opinions and shaping the game’s direction together. Today, I would like to share our thoughts on the major issues from day one and our plans to address them. [/p][p] [/p][p][b]Regarding Bot Matching[/b] [/p][p]We initially designed and implemented a system that mixes in bots of an appropriate difficulty level to make the game more thrilling without causing excessive stress. [/p][p]However, we have confirmed that many of you felt you were here for tense PvP, not to fight against these unengaging, "fake" bots. [/p][p]On the other hand, there is also feedback that bots have been helpful for item farming and have improved the sense of tension and fun. In particular, many players who are not yet familiar with this genre have said that fighting bots provides a stepping stone to more advanced combat, serving as a shortcut to becoming skilled players. [/p][p]In short, we have been able to confirm that players approach each game mode with different expectations. [/p][list][*][p][b]Quick Match:[/b] For players whose main goal is to quickly enter a dungeon and hunt for loot. [/p][/*][/list][list][*][p][b]Ranked:[/b] For players who want to prove their skills through tense, high-stakes battles against other players. [/p][/*][/list][p]Therefore, we plan to remove bots completely from the Ranked modes (3-Person/1-Person) to align with player expectations. [/p][p]For Quick Match, bots will continue to appear. However, to avoid the current situation of having too many bots, we will prioritize player-vs-player matchmaking first and then lower the number of bots that are added compared to now. [/p][p]Additionally, I’d like to clarify a misunderstanding about our bot matching logic. [/p][p]Even if the pre-game lobby is filled with bots, our logic is designed to forcibly remove a bot and replace it with a real player whenever a suitable player attempts to join. Therefore, I want to assure you that excessive bot matching does not eliminate opportunities for player-vs-player encounters. We promise to continue doing our best to match you with real players of similar skill levels. [/p][p][b]Regarding Other Major Bugs[/b] [/p][p]Our entire development team is working around the clock to provide a smooth and pleasant gameplay experience. We are dedicating all our resources to resolving reported issues as our top priority, including matchmaking errors, lag, quest count errors, Quick Match play count errors, and item purchase errors. [/p][p]We will provide a separate notice with detailed specs on the bot matching logic changes and major bug fixes as soon as a schedule is confirmed. [/p][p]We regret that we couldn't fully meet your expectations on the first day of Early Access due to these various issues, but we will continue to communicate with you and improve the game. [/p][p]I look forward to seeing you in the dungeon. [/p][p]Thank you. [/p]

notes.title: Dev Blog #9 - Part 1
notes.content:
[p]Hello, Stalkers. 
As summer approaches and we prepare for Early Access, the Dungeon Stalkers development team wishes you peace and happiness. [/p][p][/p][p]In this Developer Blog, we’d like to share our thoughts and actions based on feedback and data collected from the Final Test. We hope to communicate what issues arose during the test, what feedback we received, and how the development team is responding. [/p][p]Before we begin, we want to emphasize that we are always open to feedback. We categorize your feedback into causes and effects, delve deeply into them, and engage in extensive discussions to derive their meaning. 
Because an online PvP-based game naturally invites a wide range of experiences, opinions, and even conflicts, it’s impossible to implement every suggested solution. 
However, we ask that you never stop giving us feedback or raising issues. Each piece of your input helps guide us forward—even when we’re lost in the dark. [/p][p][img src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAAAXNSR0IArs4c6QAAAARnQU1BAACxjwv8YQUAAAAJcEhZcwAADsMAAA7DAcdvqGQAAAANSURBVBhXY2BgYGAAAAAFAAGKM+MAAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC"][/img] [/p][h2][b]1. Game Content[/b] [/h2][h3][b]1.1 Challenge and Rewards in Adventure Mode (PVE)[/b] [/h3][p]Some players shared that Adventure Mode (PVE) lacks sufficient challenge and loot, weakening motivation, and suggested the addition of loot priority. 
 [/p][p]Adventure Mode was designed as the primary entry point for many players. While we will maintain its position, we plan to enhance the value of adventure during Early Access by adding new exploration content that introduces optional risks. 
Additionally, we are researching and developing [b]Instance Looting[/b] for all modes, including PVE monsters and treasure chests. 
Instance Looting is rarely attempted in extraction games as it can greatly hinder immersion, so we’re approaching it carefully from a user experience standpoint. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]1.2 Lack of Out-of-Game Content[/b] [/h3][p]Some noted a lack of depth and volume in out-of-game content. [/p][p] 
We interpreted this as an issue stemming from non-circulating out-game systems and unconvincing content rewards. 
We are improving [b]Adventure Coin acquisition[/b], and restructuring content so players can purchase various rewards and blueprints to craft desired legendary gear in the Workshop. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]1.3 Need for a Training Room[/b] [/h3][p]Players suggested the need for a training area to test characters without matchmaking. [/p][p] 
We’re working on adding a [b]Training Room[/b] in the future. 
This will be more than a simple dummy test: you’ll be able to test various builds using consumables and legendary equipment. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]1.4 Lack of Meaning in Stalkers’ Levels[/b] [/h3][p]Some felt that Stalker level lacks practical meaning. [/p][p] 
We wanted to avoid players feeling defeated simply because of a level difference in combat, so we chose to remove direct level-based advantages. 
We are currently working on an [b]experience-based ranking system[/b] per Stalker to provide honorary rewards during Early Access. In the upcoming [b]Profile System[/b], we also plan to give seasonal honorary rewards based on level achievements. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]1.5 Stalker Skill Swapping[/b] [/h3][p]There was feedback that the fixed Active Skill (QECV) set for each Stalker limits strategic options. [/p][p] 
We agree that free skill combinations offer compelling strategic depth. 
However, we chose fixed skill sets because we believe allowing free combinations could reduce the overall quality of individual skills more than it would increase strategic variety. 
We aim to achieve both strategic depth and skill quality through [b]skill enhancement or transformation via legendary equipment[/b]. 
We ask for your continued support and active feedback as we proceed. [/p][p][img src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAAAXNSR0IArs4c6QAAAARnQU1BAACxjwv8YQUAAAAJcEhZcwAADsMAAA7DAcdvqGQAAAANSURBVBhXY2BgYGAAAAAFAAGKM+MAAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC"][/img] [/p][h2][b]2. Game Systems & Stability[/b] [/h2][h3][b]2.1 Game Freezing/Crashing[/b] [/h3][p]Extended play sessions caused freezing, and in such cases, corpses wouldn’t remain, resulting in complete equipment loss. 
We are researching solutions to [b]enhance stability[/b] regarding freezing and crashing. 
Additionally, we’re implementing [b]Reconnect[/b] functionality. If your game crashes unexpectedly, you’ll be able to re-enter that session and resume play. However, please note that Stalkers left in the dungeon during this process may be unintentionally exposed to danger. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]2.2 Matchmaking System Improvements[/b] [/h3][p]Some users experienced UX issues when preparing for matchmaking and suggested the need for regional matching in dungeon lobbies. 
During the Final Test, [b]MMR-based matchmaking[/b] and [b]detailed equipment score matching[/b] excessively fragmented the player pool. 
We’re optimizing equipment-based matching to suit player population and adding [b]regional matching[/b] as well. [/p][p][img src="data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAEAAAABCAYAAAAfFcSJAAAAAXNSR0IArs4c6QAAAARnQU1BAACxjwv8YQUAAAAJcEhZcwAADsMAAA7DAcdvqGQAAAANSURBVBhXY2BgYGAAAAAFAAGKM+MAAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC"][/img] [/p][h2][b]3. Combat & Balance[/b] [/h2][h3][b]3.1 Stalker Balance[/b] [/h3][p]There was varied feedback regarding character balance, the overwhelming performance of some legendary gear, and clunky skill execution. 
We adjusted stats based on various [b]PvP indicators and data[/b]. 
We assign each Stalker a role and balance them by analyzing tendencies within that role. Since the game is based on [b]3v3 team fights[/b], some Stalkers may naturally be stronger or weaker in [b]1v1 scenarios[/b]. 
For legendary gear, we investigated various causes and made adjustments—such as [b]tuning excessive survivability[/b] from shields and [b]removing fixed animations[/b] that hindered responsiveness (including some of Nave’s skills). [/p][p][/p][h3][b]3.2 CC Skill Balance[/b] [/h3][p]Some CC effects (stuns and staggers) were reported to be too powerful, with stagger skills being unblockable, making it too easy to dominate. [/p][p] 
Our data showed high win rates for Stalkers who frequently inflicted stagger, and stun-based Stalkers had higher-than-intended kill potential. 
We’ve [b]reduced stun durations[/b], and [b]modified stagger skills[/b] so they can now be blocked with shields or weapons. [/p][p][/p][h3][b]3.3 Ranged Aiming Issues[/b] [/h3][p]There was feedback that the crosshair did not align with the actual hit location of ranged attacks. 
This was an error introduced while adjusting the third-person camera to widen the field of view.

notes.title: Dev Blog #8
notes.content:
Hello Stalkers!

The Final Test of Dungeon Stalkers is approaching on June 25, 2025.
As we prepare for this final phase, we would like to reflect on the previous issues and concerns surrounding Dungeon Stalkers, share our internal deliberations, and explain the direction we’ve taken in development.
________________________________________

[h2]1. Controversy over Genre Similarities and Lack of Originality[/h2]


After the third test in August 2024, our development team redefined the game as a "light extraction" genre to enhance its competitiveness and sustainability.
Rather than launching as a fast follower of the existing genre, we prioritized adapting to the shifting market trends. Compared to when we first began development, the current gaming landscape places significantly more value on players' time and emphasizes solo-focused gameplay. One failed escape led to a more severe punishment than ever.
We've seen many excellent games strictly follow genre norms but ultimately fail to overcome these market challenges. So we knew we had to evolve.
In our efforts to survive and stand out, we adopted the term "light extraction" as a unique identity.
An example of us taking this new direction is how we simplified the game into three main modes:
[list]
[*] Quick Match Mode (a casual competitive mode without equipment loss)
[*] Ranked Mode (high risk, high reward)
[*] Adventure Mode (PvE-focused co-op exploration)
[/list]
Each mode supports different playstyles:

[h3][b]Quick Match (3-player / solo)[/b][/h3]

This PvEvP mode protects equipped gear and is designed to offer a lighter, more accessible extraction experience.
There are no shrinking zones and fixed escape routes are available, reducing pressure around survival and escape. Players can focus on fast-paced, aggressive gameplay, and even if they fail to escape, it’s easy to jump into the next match.

[h3][b]Ranked Match (3-player)[/b][/h3]

This PvEvP mode does not protect your equipment, embracing the intense tension unique to extraction games.
It offers higher-tier rewards, but with stronger monsters, shrinking zones, and no fixed escape routes.
This mode is deliberately designed to challenge player expectations and push their resource limits.
Survival is tough, and escape failure is common—ideal for players seeking tense, high-stakes looting and decision-making.

[h3][b]Adventure Mode[/b][/h3]

A PvE-only mode with no hostile players.
It’s meant to offer satisfaction through combat with monsters and dungeon exploration, with rewards slowly accumulating in your stash.
Once players are familiar with the monsters, the stress level is minimal—making it perfect for those who want a relaxing end to the day, exploring dungeons with charming Stalkers and filling their bags with loot.
Most content is available through this mode, and PvP is never forced by the system or content.

[h2]2. Balance[/h2]

Balance encompasses many intertwined issues.
Key problems we tackled:
[list]
[*] Melee characters had lower survivability compared to ranged ones.
[*] Random equipment options had too much impact.
[*] Matchmaking did not account for equipment strength, often pairing under-geared players against opponents with absurdly powerful gear, leading to unfair and frustrating losses.
[/list]

[h3][b]Difficulty Adjustments[/b][/h3]
We rebalanced class skills and monster difficulty, and added armor repair items to improve melee character survivability.

[h3][b]Matchmaking Improvements[/b][/h3]
We introduced MMR (matchmaking rating) and gear score, enabling tier-based matchmaking to ensure more balanced pairings.

[h3]Future Plans[/h3]
We plan to further tune Ranked Mode difficulty and add a teaming penalty system.

[h2]3. Farming and Reward Satisfaction[/h2]

Previously, item variety was lacking, and there were no "jackpot" high-value items.
Low-tier treasure items were basically dead weight in your inventory.
Through improvements, we’ve added:
[list]
[*] Valuable items that you would want to keep in your safe bag
[*] High-grade crafting materials
[*] Rare monster collectibles
[*] Fixed structural issues with treasure items, enhancing their relative value
[/list]

[h3][b]Farming Variety[/b][/h3]

More content = more item types: legendary crafting materials, rare resources, collectibles, treasures, etc.
We've focused on diversifying the decision-making around what to take in your limited inventory space.


[h3][b]Treasure Item System Overhaul[/b][/h3]

Treasure items now stack by rarity, allowing more efficient use of inventory slots.
Even low-rarity treasures can be collected in bulk to achieve high value.


[h3][b]Adventure Coins[/b][/h3]

A new universal currency earned through any form of gameplay.
They can be spent on rune systems, seasonal content rewards, and eventually to purchase Stalkers themselves.


[h3][b]Blueprints[/b][/h3]

Unresetting seasonal rewards called Blueprints were added as a final seasonal goal.
We’re developing content that allows players to craft legendary items with these, especially during Early Access.
A few of these crafting experiences will be available during the Final Test.

[h2][b]4. Server and Technical Issues[/b][/h2]

To address the technical issues reported in previous tests, we took several actions:

[h3][b]Anti-Cheat & Lag[/b][/h3]

We enhanced our anti-cheat solution and server-side validation to reduce both lag and cheating.


[h3][b]Kill Cam & Reporting[/b][/h3]

Kill cam and a connected reporting system were added to help trace and remove cheaters.
We plan to improve this with a more advanced ban/report system in the future.

[h2]5. UI/UX & New Player Accessibility[/h2]

We overhauled the entire UI and made broad UX improvements.
You’ll be able to experience the updated interface in the Final Test.

[h3][b]Future Plans[/b][/h3]

Post-Final Test, we’ll update the lobby scene and in-game HUD.


[h2]6. Character Design Issue[/h2]

We remain open-minded on how to best express the appeal of our characters and are committed to not repeating past mistakes.
We are sincerely sorry to all the users who supported us, and we understand it won’t be easy to regain your trust.
We ask that you continue to watch our new Stalkers and costumes—and keep giving us feedback and criticism to help us stay on track.

[h3][b]Body Shape Adjustments[/b][/h3]

Hilda has been modified, with bigger proportions to fit a bigger torso size.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/1a165a8cbb0b042ad1feff94fffeaec5ed887594.jpg[/img]


[h3][b]Costumes[/b][/h3]

We’ve added a variety of new costumes, with more planned.

________________________________________

It’s been a long time since we last showcased the game.
Looking back, Dungeon Stalkers had many flaws and failed to carve out a competitive edge in the market.
Without refining the game over time, we would have remained just a faint star among countless outstanding titles from talented studios.
Thanks to long, dedicated efforts, Dungeon Stalkers is still far from perfect, but it has finally taken shape—enough to show itself to all of you.
Through the Final Test and Early Access, the game will continue to grow in a clearer direction, shaped by your feedback.
We hope you’ll join us on that journey.
We look forward to meeting you in the dungeon.
Thank you.

notes.title: Dev Blog #7
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/dad5b2fa4373b3dddfdbf3b73943fe14ffce83a1.png[/img]

Hello Stalkers!
In this time when the warm energy of 2025 is spreading, we are happy to meet the Stalkers again with a  7th Dev blog. 
We sincerely thank you for your continued interest and support for Dungeon Stalkers.

In this developer’s note, rather than introducing specific features, we would like to share the current situation and future vision of the development team.



[h2]Final Test and Early Access Plan[/h2]
[i]“After the final test, Early Access to Dungeon Stalkers will proceed immediately.”[/i]


We would like to share the future plans of Dungeon Stalkers with Stalkers who have been waiting.

Currently, the development team is preparing for the final test and is making every effort to ensure a smooth Early Access.

Through several beta tests, we have collected various feedback and have been making steady improvements based on this.After the final test, which is the last inspection stage, we plan to meet the stalkers with early access right away.

The final test will not only be a simple verification but will also serve as the final gateway to Early Access.

Currently, the exact schedule for the final test and Early Access is being internally coordinated, and we are carefully reviewing the optimal timing to present it in a highly complete state.

As soon as the schedule is confirmed, we will announce it first through official channels, so we would appreciate it if you could wait a little longer.




[h2]Current Development Status[/h2]
[i]“The core system of the game and preparations for stable live service are entering their final stage.”[/i]


Our development team is focused on content development and stabilization, aiming for the final test and subsequent Early Access. At the same time, we are also building a solid foundation for our live service and business model.

Here are some of the key things we are working on right now:

[list]
[*] System and Mechanics : New Passive System, Hideout, Legendary Weapon Crafting 
[*] User Experience : UI/UX Revamp, Combat Improvements
[*] Business and Live Operations : Store Setup, Season Event Planning
[/list]

We totally get why some of you might be worried about delays with all these new additions. But, these are all core features that we planned from the very beginning, and we are now putting the finishing touches on them to make sure they are top notch.

We are doing our absolute best to address any issues and make sure Dungeon Stalkers live up to your expectations, especially after you have been so patient with us.

We believe the best way to thank you for waiting is to deliver a game that is a ton of fun and super stable.



[h2]Future Plans, Extraction-Lite[/h2]
[i]“Dungeon Stalkers is redefining the ‘Extraction-Lite’ genre with a focus on optional risks and excitement!”[/i]


Dungeon Stalkers is aiming to be an ‘Extraction-Lite’ game, where you get to choose how much tension you want to experience.

We have toned down the super harsh penalties you find in some extraction games because we know everyone’s time is super valuable these days. We still think risk is a big part of the genre, but we want that risk to be your choice, not something you have forced into.

As we have mentioned in previous notes, Dungeon Stalkers’ PVEVP mode has two main flavors:


[b]·     Quick Match (1 Player / 3 Players)[/b]
→ If you don’t escape, you will lose the items in your bag, but you get to keep your equipped gear.

[b]·     Competitive Match (3 Players)[/b]
→ If you don’t escape, you will lose everything, including your equipment. But, the dungeons are tougher, there are zone restrictions (like a shrinking circle), and you will find much better rewards and loot.


In the future, we are planning to add instance based PVP modes to Quick Matches based on what you guys like, or maybe even things like season rankings, tiers, and special rewards to Competitive Matches.

We are also constantly thinking about expanding our PVE content beyond just combat and making sure we cater to all sorts of playstyles.



[h2]A Promise About Characters[/h2]
[i]“We're making lots of changes to how your Stalkers look and express themselves, and we're going to give you way more options!”[/i]


We have heard your feedback about Stalker appearances and costumes loud and clear, and we are having lots of serious chats and making some bold decisions to make sure everything fits the vibe of Dungeon Stalkers.

We have made some big changes to our design direction lately, and we think you're going to be really happy with the results.

Dungeon Stalkers is aiming to have its own unique style that you won't find anywhere else, and we're planning to add tons of costumes and appearance options to fit everyone's tastes. We want you to have plenty of ways to make your Stalker truly your own!




[hr][/hr]



[b][i]To conclude[/i][/b]
[i]“We'll be back soon with a polished game that's worth the wait!”[/i]

We want to say a huge thank you to all the Stalkers who've been waiting so patiently for Dungeon Stalkers. The team is working around the clock to get you a fantastic game as soon as we can.

We can't wait to see you all in the final test and Early Access. We'll announce the exact dates on our official channels as soon as they are confirmed, so please stay tuned!

And, if you have any questions or anything you want to ask, feel free to drop them in our official community, especially on Discord. We will do our best to answer everything we can.

We're going to do everything in our power to deliver a game that's worthy of your excitement. Thanks again from the bottom of our hearts!


Sincerely,

The Dungeon Stalkers Development Team

notes.title: Dev Blog #6
notes.content:
Hello Stalkers! 
Thank you to all Stalkers for your continued interest in Dungeon Stalkers.
The development team is constantly working hard to improve the game and deliver an even better experience. 


Today, we would like to share some of our recent discussions regarding the direction of seasonal and regular content, with a focus on content and system improvements.


Our primary goal is to ensure that regular content doesn't become too complex and burdensome for our Stalkers. We are also considering a permanent reward system that will provide meaningful incentives for consistent play, taking into account the game's seasonal reset structure.


We have decided to focus our regular content around three core themes: "Account Progression," "Build Customization," and "Equipment Growth," and are working diligently to bring these concepts to life.


We will continue to strive for continuous improvement and development to provide you with an even more satisfying experience.


[h2]Passive Skills[/h2]
[i]“Passive skills have been changed to account progression, allowing you to combine effects suitable for your role and easily manage them through presets without the burden of repetitive farming.”[/i]


Previously, passive skills required repetitive growth for each Stalker with the same content. However, the development team recognized that this structure caused unnecessary repetition and decided to make a change.

Passive skills will now be changed to account-wide progression content. You can select two groups to combine main and sub effects, allowing you to set abilities and stats suitable for your role. You will first grow and configure the "Account Growth" effect that applies to all Stalkers.

In addition, the set passives can be easily managed through the preset management function, allowing you to save multiple pages and quickly switch between different builds. 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/76a11c0c6d4a6e67791d159c8492c32b5cb3ed4f.jpg[/img]

[i]* This image is a work in progress and may be subject to change in the future[/i]


[h2]Legendary Item Revamp & Crafting System[/h2]
[i]“Legendary items, including a special effect, will become a core element for skill enhancement and transformation. To make it easier to utilize, a new ‘Crafting’ System will be introduced.”[/i]


Legendary tier items include the effects of the existing ‘Specialty’ content and can enhance or transform a Stalkers’ skill when equipped. As a result, wearing specific legendary equipment plays an important role in build configuration.

For example, equipping the legendary staff called ‘SpellKeeper’ fires 2 magic arrows(Q). To facilitate this build configuration, it was essential to reduce the burden of acquiring and equipping legendary items. To compensate for this, a revamped ‘Crafting’ System will be introduced, and details will be covered in the ‘camp’ section below.  
 

[h2]Camp[/h2]
[i]“You will be able to own a personal space called ‘Camp’. you can utilize functions such as equipment crafting and storage expansion in your Camp.”[/i]


Now stalkers can rest and maintain their equipment in their personal camp after completing expeditions. In addition to functions such as storage expansion, you can utilize the revamped ‘Crafting’ System by constructing a crafting table here.

In the new crafting system, after constructing a crafting table of a specific level , you can craft items unlocked in the blueprint codex by consuming only materials.

Blueprints are provided as main rewards for the season and are planned as non-resettable assets even after the season ends.


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/5753ef5e595ff00ed6304891bae21518204408b2.png[/img]

[i]* This image is a work in progress and may be subject to change in the future[/i]

Factions, influential organizations in the Dungeon Stalkers world, give missions to Stalkers and support their adventures.

notes.title: Dev Blog #5
notes.content:
Hello, Stalkers!

We are back with our fifth Dev Blog, wrapping up a busy January 2025!

We hope that your plans for this year are going smoothly and that everyone’s steps lead to happiness.

Today, we’re going to take some time to talk about the recent developments made to the combat systems during the development of Dungeon Stalkers, the choices made by the development team, and the direction we are aiming for.



[h2]Ultimate Skill Improvement[/h2]
[i]“We are giving the mage Nave, and the warrior Baran a major upgrade to their ultimate skills, so they can really perform dramatically when the going gets tough.”[/i]


Nave’s ultimate skill has been changed to a magic that fires a beam straight ahead, dealing continuous damage, and Baran’s ultimate skill has been changed to a skill that deals powerful area damage in a fan shape area using the existing skill ‘Death Crush’.

They will become true forces on the battlefield, Nave as a devastating ranged attacker and Baran as an unstoppable force. Use your new ultimate skills to change the course of battle!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/eb33ccd0caae01870c4e79596076f4c5b32780a8.jpg[/img]
[b]Mana Stone - Unleashed[/b]


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/bbfbc3d8dc565605e96001f429ebef03100c1140.jpg[/img]
[b]Mana Stone - Death Crush[/b]



[h2]Control Improvement[/h2]
[i]“We are trying to naturally reduce the discrepancy between the player’s judgement and actual actions when a[b]ttacking, defending, and casting skills[/b] during battle.”[/i]


The development team has consistently received feedback regarding the frustration caused by attacking, defending, and casting skills during battle, and we have recognized this as an important issue, and have been considering the causes in various ways. After much discussion, we have decided to improve the following first.


[b]- The discrepancy between the player’s judgement and the actual end point of the action[/b]
For example, after using Hilda’s skill “Bladeslam”, the player feels that the action has ended when the sword’s attack has ended. However, in reality, additional delays occur due to the animation of putting away the sword and getting up, and Hilda remains in place for a longer time than the player’s judgment.

We defined this time as “frustration”.

This delay was initially intended as a strategic element, giving opponents a window to counterattack.

While we understand the appeal of this deliberate pace, we felt it was ultimately hindering the overall gameplay experience.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/9da2dd3732590ebf202dece85b93a71555215261.png[/img]

As shown in the image above, we have added a point where the next action is connected to various skills and general attack actions, including Hilda’s ‘Bladeslam’.
Players will now be able to escape from the delay in action that causes a discrepancy between the actual action and their judgement, and they will be able to feel the difference between the fast paced and heavy actions.



[h2]Other Battle Improvement[/h2]
[i]“We have removed the stun animation when armor is destroyed to make the battle tempo faster and smoother.”[/i]


Now, even if the armor is destroyed, no stun animation will occur.

Previously, if the armor was destroyed during the actions, the action would be canceled, and the character would be knocked down defenseless. Exploiting this weakness was an important strategic element in the past battle policy, but in the current faster and smoother battle tempo, this penalty felt excessive. 

Therefore, we have boldly removed the stun animation to provide a smoother battle experience.
 
 
[hr][/hr]
 
 
[i][b]To Conclusion…[/b][/i]
As one of the development team, 
I apologize that I can only explain the situation to those who are waiting through words. 
We are doing our best to meet the Stalkers and to repay the valuable feedback you have sent us for Dungeon Stalkers.

Since the last test, the development team has been dedicated to development based on the following principles:

- Creating a high quality seasonal party matching game
- Reducing play stress difficulty
- Strengthening the unique characteristics and character of each Stalker

We are specifically targeting 3 player party based matching games. Our goal is to offer a smooth matchmaking process, polished gameplay, and a seamless transition to the next level.


We are also working on improving areas where each class’s unique personality and strengths were not fully utilized. (For example, we have added stealth abilities to Rio) We are also deep in discussions about enhancing the visual appeal and individuality of our characters, and we are developing a concrete plan based on these discussions that we will be implementing gradually.

We will continue to share our development team’s thoughts and direction with you. If you have any questions that were not covered in this Dev Blog or topics you would like to see in the next chapter, feel free to leave feedback on our [b]Discord[/b] or [b]Steam community[/b]. 

Thank you again from the bottom of our hearts to all the Stalkers who have shown their continued interest in Dungeon Stalkers.

notes.title: Dev Blog #4
notes.content:
Hello, Stalkers!

As December winds down, we’re excited to bring you the fourth Developer's Note.

We hope you're enjoying a cozy and joyful time with your loved ones. Here’s to a new year filled with happiness and good health!

In this update, we’ll dive into how Dungeon Stalkers is gearing up for crucial aspects of multiplayer gaming, including ensuring service stability and tackling disruptive behavior. We’ll also share progress on costume creation—something many of you have been eagerly awaiting.

Stay tuned!


[h2]Building a Stable Playing Environment[/h2]

[i]“Based on insights from previous tests, we’ve reinforced server stability and are working to deliver a more reliable experience in the next phase of service."[/i]

Through three rounds of official testing, Dungeon Stalkers has identified and addressed various server stability challenges under diverse conditions. While these tests may have caused some inconvenience, they were invaluable in driving improvements. We sincerely thank all participants for their patience and support throughout the process.

In the version currently undergoing internal testing, we’ve resolved many major issues, such as game delays and matchmaking instability. With these improvements, we’re confident that the next service phase will offer a more stable and enjoyable gameplay experience.


[h2]Implementing Anti-Cheat Measures and Strengthening Server Validation[/h2]

[i]“We plan to combat unauthorized programs with proven anti-cheat solutions and enhanced server-side validation.”[/i]

Dungeon Stalkers has consistently addressed reports of unauthorized program use and hacking during testing phases. Building on these efforts, we’ve implemented a market-proven anti-cheat solution and significantly strengthened server-side validation logic to greatly reduce the likelihood of hacking attempts.

Even if used out of curiosity or for fun, unauthorized programs disrupt fair gameplay and harm the experience for many players. We urge everyone to refrain from using such programs, as violations will result in penalties in accordance with our operational policies, without exception.

Let’s work together to maintain a fair and enjoyable gaming environment!


[h2]Introducing the Kill Cam[/h2]

[i]"Quick Problem Resolution with an Easy-to-Use Reporting Interface"[/i]

Despite ongoing improvements to our anti-cheat systems and server validation, misconduct can still occur in unpredictable ways. To address these challenges swiftly, we’re introducing a Kill Cam feature.

This feature will allow players to review instances where they were eliminated or encountered questionable gameplay, providing a simple and intuitive interface for reporting any suspicious behavior.

With Kill Cam, we aim to empower players to help maintain a fair and competitive environment while enabling us to respond to issues more effectively.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/072287b09faf03c508a4493b548090854866561e.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/ee978962a432996a3e4559666acc2a31821bec04.gif[/img]
[i]*This image is from a test build and is subject to change.[/i]

Following Early Access, we will enhance ongoing monitoring of hacking and unauthorized programs, maintaining a steadfast commitment to ensuring a fair and secure gaming environment.



+ 💡Bonus

[h2]Revealing Concept Art for New Costumes[/h2]

[i]“Excited for new costumes for your Stalkers?”[/i]

We’ve been listening to your feedback about wanting more visually appealing character designs, and we’re excited to finally share a first look at the concept art for some upcoming costumes.

Our team is working hard to create a diverse range of designs that bring even more charm and personality to your Stalkers. We hope you’re as excited as we are for what’s to come! Stay tuned for more updates.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/cbf563cf4af6133dd9a6abefe4841ba2cf447124.png[/img]

[i]*Please note that this image is a work-in-progress and may be subject to change.[/i]

We’re actively preparing a variety of costume concepts, with plans to release new and exciting skins on a regular basis following Early Access. We can’t wait to share them with you, so stay tuned!


That concludes this installment of Dev Blog #4.
As always, we’ll finish by answering some of the questions you’ve sent our way.
Thank you for your support!


[h2]Thank you for your support![/h2]

Q. What are your thoughts on removing the ability to replace broken armor with another, or shifting its focus from additional health to other attributes like defense?

[quote=author]A. We’ve tested various approaches to the armor replacement system internally, and ultimately found the current system more engaging from a gameplay perspective. However, we plan to adjust the duration of the armor replacement process, which has been a bit lengthy. Additionally, we’re introducing a system where players can partially restore durability using an “Armor Repair Kit” obtainable in dungeons.[/quote]


Q. You previously mentioned a “restructuring of the skill system” in Dev Blog #3. Could you explain in more detail how it differs from the current system? I’m also curious to learn more about the “Perk System.”

[quote=author]A.The current passive skill system, which requires each Stalker to individually purchase and learn skills, will be revamped into the (tentatively named) Rune System. This update will streamline the process, allowing passive skills purchased at the account level to be easily applied to individual Stalkers. Additionally, players will be able to create and manage customized preset pages for their skill setups.

The new Perk System will introduce a range of enhancements, from minor boosts to skill power, to entirely new effects for skills. This system aims to add greater depth and flexibility to skill configurations, giving players more options to tailor their gameplay.
[/quote]


Q. With many new characters being introduced, is there a risk that their development will delay releases or affect the timeline for other improvements?

[quote=author]A. The release schedule for new characters is progressing smoothly as planned, without causing delays to other updates or improvements. In fact, these efforts are part of our commitment to delivering richer content. We appreciate your continued interest and feedback as we strive to enhance the game.[/quote]


Q.  Are the designs of revealed characters finalized? Will updates include features like blinking animations?

[quote=author]A. Both existing and upcoming character designs are being refined based on player feedback to improve their overall quality. For instance, while it may not have been noticeable from the screenshots, Hilda’s body shape has undergone slight adjustments.
We also plan to implement facial animations, such as blinking, in future updates to further enhance character expressions.[/quote]


Q. Are there plans to introduce new traps or enemies? While new characters are great, adding these elements could make the game even more enjoyable.

[quote=author]A. As mentioned in earlier updates, we are planning to offer a variety of maps. Although the release timing will depend on development progress, our second map is expected to provide a distinctly different exploration experience compared to the prison dungeon, complete with new enemies and challenges.[/quote]


Q. When will the new character wrapped in bandages, shown in the key art, be revealed?

[quote=author]A. This character is planned to join the roster in a future update following the release of Lián. We look forward to sharing their concept and backstory with you soon. Stay tuned for more details on this character and other upcoming additions![/quote]
