notes.title: Dev Blog #3
notes.content:
Hello Stalkers! 
We want to share some information about what is happening behind the scenes here on the Dungeon Stalkers Team! 

Today’s topic focuses on the core of Dungeon Stalkers’ combat: a revamp of the skill system and a redesign of ultimate abilities.

And for the first time ever, get a sneak peek at our brand-new Stalker, ‘Lián’.


[h2]Reconstruction of the Skill System[/h2]
[i]"To enhance clarity and ensure diversity, we’re introducing fixed skill slots alongside a Perk system to improve both efficiency and balance."[/i]

Dungeon Stalkers’ previous skill system provided a wide range of abilities for each character, offering players the freedom to tailor gameplay to their preferences. However, we found that a small selection of highly efficient skills dominated usage, disrupting the intended balance between characters.

To address this, we plan to implement a fixed skill slot system based on order or placement. This simplification is expected to make communication and discussions among players more straightforward and intuitive.

The previous free placement system will be replaced with a fixed slot structure, as shown below:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/6f744de562ec6c13e018c2c379327c71738a314f.png[/img]
[i]*Skill names are based on the development version and are subject to change in the future.[/i]


To address the issue of reduced diversity in skill setups, we plan to complement it through the diversification of [b]the Perk system.[/b] We will discuss the changes to the Perk system in more detail in a future update.


[h2]Ultimate Abilities Reflecting the Stalker’s Identity[/h2]
[i]"We’re revamping ultimates to align with each Stalker’s role and class, offering fresh changes to the gameplay experience."[/i]

During previous tests, we received significant feedback regarding the ultimate system, with two key issues highlighted:
[list]
[*]All Stalkers used ultimates in the same way (breaking a Mana Stone to activate effects for a limited time).
[*]The long activation time for ultimates made them difficult to use in high-pressure combat situations.
[/list]
To address these concerns, the development team has decided to redesign the ultimate abilities to 
match each Stalker’s role and class. Here are a couple of examples of the revamped ultimates:

[list]
[*] [b]Rio[/b]: As a rogue-type Stalker, Rio’s ultimate will enhance stealth and tracking abilities while dealing significant damage to enemies in a limited area from behind.
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/d4667d024936eec0123a89226d0b62124b64dd02.gif[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/2b577b72b2c8df308751508786dd89c27735b91e.gif[/img]
[i]*Skill names are based on the development version and are subject to change in the future.[/i]


Beside this, we plan to carefully review each Stalker’s ultimate ability and assign new skills that align with the concept of their respective class.

However, if the existing ultimate abilities are suitable for the concept, they will be retained, and the ultimate casting delay when breaking a Mana Stone will be significantly reduced for all classes.


[h2]Eighth Lotus ‘Lián’[/h2]

[i]"A mysterious archer stepping into an unfamiliar world to complete her trial of enlightenment."[/i]

Lián is a young woman from a distant land, hailing from deep within the mountains of a faraway continent. As a disciple on the path of harmony, she was granted the name of the mystical lotus by her master. Her final trial is to retrieve the "Moonlight Lotus," hidden within a dungeon created amidst the chaos of two warring nations.

Although she knows little of the world or the "Moonlight Lotus," Lián understands that this journey is essential to completing her enlightenment. Every challenge she faces in this harsh world will deepen her understanding of herself, her abilities, and her purpose, guiding her toward true wisdom and strengthening her resolve.

[i]No matter what she witnesses or loses…[/i]

Lián is a skilled archer who excels in combining archery with mystical techniques and martial arts honed through her training. These abilities make her archery skills even more formidable and unique.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/dc5b335612edef348a866774fd8838dbb5f36287.png[/img]
[i]*This image is a work in progress and may be subject to change in the future[/i]


That’s all for today’s Dev Blog.

Every piece of feedback and each question from our Stalkers is incredibly valuable to us. If you share your thoughts on Discord and the Steam community, we will continue to improve the game in return.

Next, we will conclude with answers to some of the questions we’ve received from the community. 


[h2]l Q&A Corner[/h2]

Q. Is Rank Mode similar to the previous PvEvP mode, as explained in Dev Blog Episode 2? Or are there additional differences from the existing PvEvP mode? 

[quote=author]
A.  To clarify the differences between the previous PvEvP mode and Rank mode, based on our current version we have, it works as follows:
[list]
[*] The artificial activity range limitation through the Crimson Veil is removed.
[*] All exploration elements are revealed on the map from the start. (The escape portal will be shown from the moment it is generated.)
[*] In Rank mode, Stalkers can acquire the highest tier items in the game, and the overall item drop rate will be higher than in regular adventure modes.
[/list]
As mentioned in Dev Blog Episode 2, Rank mode will feature slightly tougher enemies and field bosses, and there will be a risk of losing a significant amount, including equipped items, upon death, which remains the same as before.
[/quote]

Q. Will the Witch’s Call system continue even after the Crimson Veil is removed?

[quote=author] A. The Crimson Veil will not completely disappear. All dungeons will only remain active for a certain period, and just before the dungeon disappears, the final Crimson Veil will trigger once, closing the dungeon.

As a result, the Witch’s Call system will be removed. Before the dungeon completely closes, stalkers can choose to battle powerful bosses via the escape portal, fixed escape points, or boss portals marked on the map.[/quote]

Q. Is Dungeon Stalkers being developed with the goal of being accessible and not hardcore, aiming for a PvPvE + extraction shooter game?

[quote=author]A. Yes, that’s correct. Currently, the extraction genre is considered to be ‘hardcore’ and difficult. Our development team firmly believes that Dungeons Stalkers can be an extraction game that anyone can enjoy, and we will continue to do our best to ensure that the game becomes accessible and appealing to a wide range of players.[/quote]

Q. Why did you decide to develop the game in third person perspective instead of the common first person perspective used in other extractions shooter games? Is it to emphasize differentiation and character identity? Also, are there plans to offer both first person and third person modes in the future, considering different player preferences?

[quote=author]A. When developing Dungeon Stalkers, the most important thing we focused on was introducing Stalkers with diverse backgrounds and concepts, offering players a variety of satisfaction.

Our development team values seeing our character’s appearance and actions within the game, which naturally led us to choose the third person perspective.

While we are not currently considering a first person perspective mode, if many stalkers request it after launch, we will carefully consider it. [/quote]

Q. Q5. In the previous tests, there were various different pathways through the dungeon, but certain areas always seem to be in the same location (for example, Goblin Mines being in the center of the map). Are there plans to have these areas randomly placed too, which will help keep the game fresh and fun?

[quote=author]A. We would love to provide dungeons with more diver exploration elements.
However, simply placing the same exploration elements in different locations may not be enough to bring the level of excitement we want.

Ultimately, we plan to increase elements like the ‘Goblin Mine’ and ‘Catacomb’ for more exploration and challenges, and we also aim to introduce dungeons with different themes, moving beyond the current prison dungeon theme.[/quote]

notes.title: Dev Blog #2
notes.content:
Hello Stalkers! 

Here we are with our second Dev Blog.

In this update, we’re excited to share improvements designed to make it easier for players new to the extraction genre to enjoy and adapt to the game, as well as enhancements to the “Rank Match” mode to maintain a high level of intensity that even experienced Stalkers will appreciate. We’ll also dive into some changes aimed at boosting the fun of dungeon exploration.

Additionally, we would like to thank you for the love and interest you’ve shown toward our new character “Shinobu”, which we introduced in the first Dev Blog.

We’re also preparing to introduce more new Stalkers set to join the dungeons soon, so please stay tuned.



[h2]Extraction Light?[/h2]
[i]“Keeping the thrill of the extraction genre while lowering the barrier to entry by reducing the risk of loss, making it more accessible to a wider audience.”[/i]


The extraction Genre has gained popularity for its intense tension, immersion, and elements of cooperation and competition. However, we have been concerned that it may be difficult to appeal to a broader audience, since there is a high entry barrier, due to the fear of losing the results of your invested time in the game.


[i]“Is there a way to reduce the feeling of loss while preserving the strengths of the game?”[/i]


After much internal discussion, we decided to test a system where, instead of losing everything upon failure to escape, only the items you carry in your bag are lost. This system allowed us to maintain an appropriate level of tension while reducing the overall burden, leading to a more enjoyable gameplay experience.

We have named this system [b]“Extraction Light”[/b] and will be[b] applying it to quick matches and adventure mode (Co-op).[/b] We believe this aligns with our goal of popularizing the dungeon fantasy extraction genre that Dungeon Stalkers strives for, and we are confident it will bring great satisfaction to our Stalkers.


[h2]Returning to the Essence of the Dungeon Crawler Genre[/h2]
[i]“To preserve the fun of dungeon exploration, we have removed the “Crimson Veil” system and will provide exploration information on the minimap to enable various strategic players.”[/i]


Dungeon Stalkers is, at its core, a fantasy dungeon crawler within the extraction genre, with dungeon exploration as a primary focus. 

However, we concluded that the existing “Crimson Veil” system, inspired by battle royale mechanics, detracted from the exploration experience. After much thought and discussion, we decided to remove the “Crimson Veil”. 

Now, players can enter dungeons with their party members and strategize around objectives like escape, looting, and boss hunting. To support this, we’ll be displaying essential exploration information on the map, allowing for more strategic and immersive gameplay.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/9251f55b798387e55d1d627da225ceb87028c9c9.png[/img]
[i] *This image is a work in progress and may be subject to change in the future.[/i]

We’re working hard to bring you an even richer dungeon experience, with new elements that offer diverse exploration and thrilling challenges. Stay tuned for the exciting changes coming your way!


[h2The Reason for Keeping Ranked Mode Separate[/h2]
[i]“We aim to preserve the unique tension and immersion that only this genre can offer. In Ranked Matches, you can earn the highest tier items, honor, differentiated rewards, and have the opportunity to challenge powerful seasonal bosses.”[/i]


Ranked matches, where everything is at risk upon failure, are designed for those who crave extreme tension, the thrill of farming, and honor.  

It’s a mode for the most daring Stalkers. Through Ranked Matches, you can achieve seasonal rankings and ratings, and challenge yourself to climb the leaderboards. The most courageous and honorable Stalkers will be rewarded with titles, ranking rewards, and various other prizes after the season ends. 


[i]“But, there should be more reasons to take on the risk in Ranked Matches beyond just honor and small rewards, right?”[/i]


As the stakes are higher, the highest tier legendary items in Dungeon Stalkers can only drop in Ranked Matches. These items will have noticeably superior stats and unique options compared to lower tier items. For example, equipment with exciting effects like those below  will be available. 

Of course there will be even more diverse and interesting effects to discover than the sample items shown in the image.  


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/fcff319f9f65ba9e18a100937b775a2b7109ba08.png[/img]
[i]*Stormbringer / Fury of Storm :Summon a lightning bolt on attack hit, dealing 33 Lightning damage to the target area.[/i]
[i]*Heartseeker / Seeker’s Tooth : Shoot 2 additional arrows, Each additional arrow deals 25% physical damage.[/i]

[i] *This image is a work in progress and may be subject to change in the future[/i]

Powerful Legendary items are tied to the right to challenge the formidable ‘Season Boss’. We will dive into more details about the Season boss in a future update.


That’s all for today’s news.

As always, your feedback and questions via Discord, Steam Community, or other channels are a huge help to us.

To wrap up, we’ll answer some questions that you’ve shared through our official Discord.


[h2]l Q&A Corner[/h2]

[b]Q. Will there be any additional monetization models beyond what was previously mentioned (Battle Pass, Emotes, Costume…)? Is there still no plan for Pay to Win elements?[/b]
[quote=author]A. We have not finalized the detailed monetization play yet. However, the two main principles will remain unchanged. The game will be Free to Play, and there will not be a Pay to Win element. These principles are not up for modification.[/quote]

[b]Q. Are there any plans to add a 2 player mode in the future?[/b]
[quote=author]A. Once we are able to provide maps of various sizes, we’ll consider adding a 2 player (Duo) mode. This will likely be after the Early Access release and in a future season.[/quote]

[b]Q. Will there be other characters released or announced besides the ones already shown?[/b]
[quote=author]A. As mentioned earlier, we are considering giving you a little hint about upcoming characters in the next developer’s note. Stay tuned! 😊[/quote]

[b]Q. I want to see Shinobu’s face without her mask! Will you reveal it?[/b]
[quote=author]A. We will discuss this with the concept and modeling teams. I know she is quite a mysterious character with that awesome mask, but we will definitely consider how to reveal it properly. We will think of something![/quote]

[b]Q. Are there any plans to improve character animations, specifically making the bust physics more natural and lifelike?[/b]
[quote=author]A. As mentioned in [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2468730/allnews/]  the announcement  [/url] after the third test, character animations will continue to be improved. Instead of focusing on a single area, we will aim to make all the animations smoother, cooler, and more natural overall! [/quote]

[b]Q. Are there any plans for modern-style costumes, or anything to further emphasize the appeal of character appearances?[/b]
[quote=author]A. We’re currently preparing a variety of costumes for each Stalker, designed to highlight different aspects of their unique traits and offer a fresh appeal distinct from their default skins. We’re also working on seasonal costumes that follow specific themes. When the time is right, we’ll share a sneak peek of some of these upcoming costumes![/quote]

notes.title: Dev Blog #1
notes.content:
Hello Stalkers!

Our first Dev Blog is here. As promised, we’re going to be releasing information 
about our latest improvements to the game, as well as exciting new content. 
We’ll also be addressing some of the topics that we’ve seen asked in the community,
and share our current vision of the game. 

Today, we’re introducing updates to game modes, enhancements to the matchmaking system, improvements to the early game experience, and an exclusive first look at our newest Stalker, "Shinobu."


[h2]1. Major Changes to Game Modes[/h2]
We're planning to simplify the current, somewhat complex game modes for a more enjoyable experience. 
We'll introduce three main modes: “Quick Battle Mode” for combat enjoyment and a more relaxed combat experience, “Competitive Match Mode” for a more competitive experience, and “Adventure Mode” focused on dungeon exploration.

*Note: Names are not yet finalized, and are subject to change. 


[h3]1) Quick Battle Mode[/h3]
This mode supports both 3-player party and solo play. 
The biggest change is that, even if you die in a match, 
you won’t lose any equipped gear (though items found and stored in your bag 
that aren’t equipped will be lost if you fail to escape).

Quick Battle Mode reduces the anxiety of losing equipped items, 
encouraging players to try different strategies and enjoy dungeon exploration 
and combat to the fullest.

[h3]2)  Competitive Match Mode[/h3]
Competitive Match Mode applies extraction rules similar to the Prison Dungeon Mode 
from previous tests—fail to escape, and you’ll lose everything. 
Compete under high tension and climb the ranks for superior rewards 
and honor compared to Quick Battle Mode. 
You can also secure a leaderboard position for yourself and your allies, 
receiving rank-based rewards each season.

[h3]3) Adventure Mode (PvE)[/h3]
Similar to Co-Op mode in previous tests, Adventure Mode focuses on PvE dungeon exploration. 
Based on feedback from the 3rd test, 
we’re working on introducing dungeons with various difficulty levels. 
Once plans are finalized, we’ll provide more details.

We hope you’re looking forward to these revamped game modes.
 
[h2]2. Matchmaking System Improvements[/h2]
[h3]1) Enhancements to the Matching Process[/h3]
The matchmaking process has been enhanced to create better-balanced parties 
by considering both players’ skill levels and gear ratings in random matches. 
Player skill will be evaluated based on indicator-driven metrics, 
and all equipped gear levels will also factor into matchmaking. 
Ultimately, the goal is to reduce skill disparities between parties, 
making for a more enjoyable gameplay experience.

Additionally, you can now preview information about party members who join during matchmaking,
allowing for better communication in the lobby. 
We’ve also added a feature to let you change your chosen Stalker before entering the dungeon, 
allowing for more strategic coordination among teammates to maximize team potential.

Other quality-of-life improvements include the ability to keep parties intact after a game
 and easily send friend requests from the party screen, 
making dungeon exploration even more enjoyable.

 
[h3]2) Improved Tutorials and AI Matches for New Players[/h3]
We recognize the challenge of introducing new players to the extraction genre. 
To make it easier for newcomers to enjoy and get accustomed to the game, 
we’re enhancing the tutorial by adding practical tutorials, 
such as those covering the Combination System, which can be directly applied in gameplay. 

Moreover, for new users who complete the tutorial, we will allow them to engage in quick matches against AI opponents before fully diving into the game. 
This will provide an opportunity to experience the fun of the extraction genre, 
helping them adapt to the game rather than facing the frustration of an overwhelming defeat.


[h2]3. New Stalker ‘Shinobu’[/h2]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/73f3f0179cdc6cd95e06a314e3fb1318fd4c42e9.png[/img]
"Hi there! I'm Shinobu, and it's a pleasure to meet you!"

She is a ninja from the mysterious Eastern land of Kayoku, 
striving to earn the title “Hanzo,” the greatest ninja. 
She also wishes to reunite with her younger brother, 
whom she was separated from at a young age. Shinobu fearlessly faces any danger.

Shinobu specializes in close combat with her dagger but also utilizes throwing stars to target enemies from a distance. 
Her unique ninja skills in martial arts and stealth are designed to disrupt and assassinate her targets.

More detailed information on Shinobu will be revealed soon, so stay tuned!
[url=https://www.youtube.com/shorts/d1BDnkpVx08] A sneak peek of New Character Shinobu's Skills [/url]


To wrap up, we’ll answer some questions that you’ve shared through our official Discord.



[h1]l Q&A Corner[/h1]

[b]Q. Will you be revealing more about the story in the future? 
I’m very interested in the story beyond the battles in Dungeon Stalkers.[/b]
[quote=author] A. We appreciate the interest many Stalkers have shown in the story, 
and we plan to convey the background of Dungeon Stalkers in various ways. 

We expect to share the background story through a variety of game trailers, 
and as the seasons progress, we will gradually reveal the story of the dungeon 
and the witch through season trailers and boss battles. [/quote]

[b]Q. In previous tests, even though each character had multiple skills, 
there were specific skills that proved to be more efficient, 
leading to players mostly using the same skills. 
Are there plans to adjust character skills to increase variety in skill usage?[/b]
[quote=author] A. Yes, skill balancing, which plays a significant role in combat, is one of the areas the development team is closely monitoring. 
We plan to adjust each Stalker's skills to create better synergy with different gear combinations. 

This will also involve substantial changes, 
such as improvements to the ultimate ability system and redesigns of certain Stalkers’ ultimates. 
We’ll keep you updated on these changes as they develop. [/quote]

[b]Q. I would love to see a variety of cosmetic costumes. 
It would be great to have awesome designs for weapons, 
as well as options to change hairstyles and other customization elements
beyond just character outfits.[/b]
[quote=author] A. We’re aiming to offer a broader range of skins 
and emotes by the time we launch Early Access. 
We’ll continue to share previews of new skins in developer notes 
and monthly updates as they become available. [/quote]

[b]Q. I hope for consistent communication from the developers. 
Are there plans for ongoing developer communication content in the future? 
I'm curious about what information will be shared.[/b]
[quote=author] A. Alongside today’s Dev Blog, we’ll continue to provide monthly updates 
to share the details of ongoing development as transparently as possible. 
We’re also preparing various forms of content to keep the lines of communication open. [/quote]

[b]Q. It would be more exciting if rare items dropped with a visual effect, like a light beam, 
or if defeated characters emitted light. Is this improvement planned?[/b]
[quote=author]A. Enhancing the “item drop excitement” is an area we’re focusing on, 
and we’re working on visual improvements one step at a time. 
The community’s suggestion to add visual effects for higher-grade item drops is 
definitely in our upcoming plans. [/quote]

[b]Q. Will the issue of Rene's summoned elemental attacking allies be improved?[/b]
[quote=author] A.  “Friendly fire” was a topic of much feedback during past tests. 
While it adds strategic depth and tension to combat, 
it can unintentionally harm team cohesion and be challenging for new players. 

After careful consideration, we’ve decided to improve gameplay 
by removing friendly fire to make Dungeon Stalkers more accessible and enjoyable for all. [/quote]

[b]Q. Many improvements are planned, but is there another test on the horizon?[/b]
[quote=author] A. The current improvements and new content we are focusing on will bring 
significant changes to the existing game, 
so we are exploring various options for showcasing them before the early access release. 
We are also working on strengthening server stability and are considering whether technical testing is necessary.

We believe that conducting tests while listening to the community’s feedback is a proactive way to communicate.

Once the testing plans are finalized, we will share the news first through the Dev Blog.  [/quote]

Our development team is committed to enhancing the game overall and adding new content to 
make Dungeon Stalkers a long-lasting, beloved experience. 
We’ll continue to share development updates and keep the conversation going 
through the Dev Blog, so please stay tuned and keep the feedback coming.

Thank you!

notes.title: Early Access Release Schedule Postponement Announcement
notes.content:
[b]Hello from the Dungeon Stalkers development team.[/b]

First and foremost, thank you to all the Stalkers who have shared their valuable time with Dungeon Stalkers. It means a lot to us that so many of you were willing to spend time playing the game that we helped create. 

We have carefully read and considered all the feedback and constructive criticism provided during the recent beta tests and Gamescom demonstrations.

After reviewing the feedback, we have come to the conclusion that there are two major areas that need addressing. We need to enhance the overall gameplay experience, and work harder to ensure that when the game is played, it is played in a stable gaming environment. 

Dungeon Stalkers have set these two core objectives as our primary goals as we prepare for the Early Access launch.

We will explain the details through the points summarized below.

[h2]1. Enhancing Gameplay[/h2]

We are currently working on four main areas to improve gameplay, detailed as follows:

[b]Strengthening Player Motivation and Maximizing the Fun of Farming[/b]
We believe it is crucial to strengthen the motivation and reasons to keep playing Dungeon Stalkers. We are reviewing various solutions to increase the diversity of items and reinforce gameplay incentives.

We also recognize that the fatigue from farming can accumulate when Stalkers repeatedly enter the prison dungeon without obtaining desirable items. We plan to improve this by ensuring that each dungeon run generates excitement for item farming.

We will enhance the fun of farming not just by creating more items with good stats, but by adjusting the options on equipment to be more useful, as well as adding legendary equipment with interesting abilities.

[b]Refining and Improving Core Systems for Smoother Combat[/b]
We aim to address the difficulties in employing various tactics in some confined areas within dungeons, allowing for more strategic party battles.

We will ensure that character ultimates can be utilized more dynamically in all situations, allowing for more strategic combat flow.

Additionally, we will adjust the balance between ranged and melee characters to facilitate smooth and engaging gameplay.

[b]Improving Character Movements[/b]
Many of you have provided feedback on the need for more intuitive character actions. We will enhance character running animations to provide a more immersive experience and review awkward attack animations for gradual improvements.

[b]Revamping UI/UX and Matchmaking Systems[/b]
We are improving the UI/UX to make the game system more intuitive and user-friendly. Specifically, we are revamping the UI/UX to make preparation for dungeon entry more convenient and intuitive.

Moreover, we will enhance the matchmaking system to help new Stalkers get accustomed to the game and ensure that experienced players can enjoy more intense and exciting gameplay.

[h2]2. Providing a Stable Gameplay Environment[/h2]

We have identified most of the causes of server instability, such as party matching failures, dungeon entry issues, and in-game delays from the last test. We are working on measures to provide a stable gameplay environment. Once again, we sincerely apologize for the server issues that caused inconvenience during the previous test period.

We are committed to providing a more seamless and stable gaming experience upon Early Access release, ensuring that similar issues do not occur.

Additionally, we are preparing to address several internal issues, including game mode adjustments..


In order for us to implement these changes and deliver a better experience, we have made the difficult decision to postpone the Early Access launch, originally planned for this fall. Dungeon Stalkers is scheduled to launch Early Access in the early part of 2025, after we implement these larger scaled improvements. 
 
We fully understand how disappointing this news might be for those who were eagerly awaiting the game this year, and we acknowledge the frustration of extending the wait. We share your eagerness to bring Dungeon Stalkers to you as soon as possible, but we ask for your patience and understanding as we strive to create a game that will stand the test of time.

The Dungeon Stalkers team is committed to responding to your continuous interest and affection, and we will do our utmost to meet your expectations.

We will continuously share more detailed information about each improvement through developer notes and community updates to keep you informed and engaged.

Thank you.

Sincerely,
Dungeon Stalkers Development Team

notes.title: 8/16 Developer Note
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/231381276caf9695d046e35972fa670bbdb78cc4.png[/img]

Hello Stalkers
Thank you so much for participating in the Dungeon Stalkers August Beta Test.

We would like to quickly update you on the most common feedback from this beta test and share our current progress and improvement plans.



Q1. The server instability during the August Beta Test is quite severe.We are experiencing frequent issues such as infinite loading screens, crashes, and rubberbanding issues.
[quote=author]First of all, we would like to offer our deepest apologies. We are encountering various issues that were not identified during internal testing, and we prioritizing the server-related issues to address them as quickly as possible. We are working to resolve the server problems as swiftly as we can.[/quote]

Q2. The default size of the stash is too small, and the cost to expand it is quite burdensome. Are there any plans to either increase the default size or adjust the cost of expansion? Additionally, managing items that take up a lot of space, such as potions and lower-tier materials, is quite cumbersome.
It would be great if there were more efficient ways to manage the stash, such as allowing the stacking of items or creating dedicated stash slots.
[quote=author]The development team is aware of the concerns regarding the inventory and stash. In the next update, we plan to significantly reduce the cost of expanding the stash. We will also increase the number of items that can be stacked to make the stash more convenient to use. Although these changes won't be implemented in the current test, we promise to improve this based on the feedback we've received from many of you.[/quote]

Q3. Are there plans to adjust the difficulty of solo dungeons? The number of monsters and bosses is too high, making the solo play mode significantly more challenging compared to squad play.
[quote=author]With the recent update, we have initially lowered the difficulty. As we conduct this test, we will gather feedback from the Stalkers and make further adjustments to achieve a more appropriate balance.[/quote]

Q4. There is a significant performance disparity between ranged and melee characters. It seems that melee characters often find themselves at a disadvantage. 
[quote=author]When the development team was balancing the game, adjustments were made to address the issue of ranged characters being too weak. This led to changes in the combat dynamics between ranged and melee characters. However, it seems that these changes may have resulted in noticeable differences for players. The development team is currently reviewing the updated combat balance and has made initial adjustments for the upcoming update. We will continue to monitor your feedback after this initial adjustment.[/quote]

Q5. The sources for acquiring gold are too limited. Please diversify the ways to earn gold.
[quote=author]We are aware that there aren't many ways to obtain gold at the moment. In the future, we plan to introduce more opportunities to earn gold through various content or provide more stable and consistent ways to acquire gold. We will ensure that players can earn a corresponding amount of gold for the time they invest in the game.[/quote]

Q6. The distance between the camera and the character is too close. The cramped map makes the field of view very limited, making it difficult to attack enemies. This is especially critical for melee characters, as their restricted vision is even more detrimental compared to ranged characters.
[quote=author]We chose to bring the camera closer to enhance the sense of pressure and immersion in the dungeon, even though it's a third-person game. However, if many of you are not satisfied with this, we believe it's best to make improvements. In the next update, we've adjusted the camera distance to slightly widen the field of view. We hope this adjustment will meet your expectations! We look forward to receiving more of your feedback in the future.[/quote]

Q7. Please increase the variety of material items and other collectible items, and make them more useful.
[quote=author]Yes, moving forward, we will create a wider variety of items to enhance diversity.[/quote]

Q8. The options on items obtained in dungeons are too simple, reducing the fun of combining them, and the impact of the options isn't very noticeable. Additionally, there needs to be a stronger sense of purpose in collecting good items.
[quote=author]The development team takes this feedback very seriously and we are committed to making improvements. We are considering a variety of options, including set items with more diverse and impactful effects. Our goal is to enhance the excitement and enjoyment of the game, and we will make adjustments accordingly.[/quote]

Q9. Could you increase the number of PVE mode attempts or remove the daily limit? I would like to enter PVE mode even after using all my attempts to continue training in the game. Also, are you considering adding a PVE mode where players don't lose their loot upon death, allowing for better training?
[quote=author]We sincerely appreciate the positive reception and love for the PVE mode. The reason we implemented a limit on PVE attempts is that we wanted players to primarily enjoy the PVEVP mode, which we believe offers the most fun. Our intention was for players to get familiar with the game through PVE and then move on to PVEVP. However, we understand your concerns about potential imbalances that could arise if we remove the attempt limit entirely. Based on the feedback from this test, we are considering adjusting the number of attempts and reducing the penalties for dying in PVE. Our goal is to make PVE more accessible and enjoyable, and we will explore various improvements to achieve that.[/quote]

Q10. I think the role and objectives of the Battlefield need to be clearer. While it's possible to obtain good equipment there, it's difficult to get matches, and the risk seems too high compared to the effort required. Do you have any plans to improve the Battlefield?
[quote=author]We acknowledge that this issue is tied to the current player count and several other factors, leading to a less than satisfactory experience. We plan to make improvements to the Battlefield to encourage more players to participate together. This will include reassessing the reward levels and transitioning the content from being constantly available to a regularly scheduled event, allowing players to engage without feeling overwhelmed. We will refine the timing and content to make the Battlefield more appealing and accessible.[/quote]

Q11. Do you have plans to improve the matchmaking system so that players are matched according to their skill level? It seems that new players are getting overwhelmed by those with better gear.
[quote=author]Currently, we don't have a skill-based matchmaking system in place because we haven't yet reached a sufficient number of players. We prioritized quicker matchmaking to allow for faster gameplay. However, once we reach our target player base, we plan to implement a system that matches players according to their skill levels. We are working hard to grow the player base quickly and introduce this system as soon as possible.[/quote]

Q12. Please improve the ping system. It's too cumbersome and inconvenient to use.
[quote=author]We will develop a new ping system to enhance its usability and make it more user-friendly.[/quote]

Q13. I would like to be able to control my character's movement while viewing the inventory in the game.
[quote=author]This suggestion requires some careful consideration before making any changes. We will continue to gather more feedback from our players and thoughtfully evaluate the best direction for improvement.[/quote]

"We would like to thank all of you who are playing Dungeon Stalkers. The game is currently in testing to gather honest feedback from our players. During the test period, we will address what can be improved quickly, and for things that can't be fixed right away, we will make sure to improve them by the time we present the game again. We are committed to making changes and ensuring that we do not disappoint you. We will continue to do our best to stabilize and improve the game during the remaining period. Please enjoy playing, and thank you!"

notes.title: August Beta Test Updates
notes.content:
Hello Stalkers!

We are thrilled to announce that the August Beta Test is finally here! 

For those of you who have been eagerly waiting since the surprise test in May, we’re excited to share the updates and changes for the August test. Dive into the enriched experience of Dungeon Stalkers and see what’s new!


[h2]📢August Beta Test Schedule[/h2]
KST : August 13th, 2024, 11:00 AM ~ August 27th, 2024, 10:59 AM
PDT : August 12th, 2024 7:00 PM ~ August 26th, 2024,  6:59 PM


[h2]📢New Contents to Experience[/h2]

[h3]1. Hall of Souls Added (Boss Raid Mode)[/h3]
- A new content allowing for boss raids has been added. To enter, you will need ‘Soul Stones’.

[quote=author]■ PD Comment
The newly added ‘Hall of Souls’ is a raid content where you can face bosses immediately. Since the combat penalties have been significantly reduced, as long as you can acquire the entry currency, ‘Soul Stones’, you don’t need to worry about losing equipment or other stalkers intruding. Soul Stones can be obtained through various means and are expected to be earned from challenges that offer high rewards.
We have worked to enhance accessibility for those who found fighting bosses via raid portals challenging. Enjoy and have fun![/quote]

[h3]2. New Theme added to the Prison Dungeon[/h3]
- A new theme, the Catacomb, has been added to the Prison Dungeon. Enjoy exploring and adventuring in this new dungeon theme!

[h3]3. New Boss Monster Added[/h3]
- A new boss, the ‘Forgotten King’, has been added to the game. 
This formidable foe can be encountered in the new catacomb theme
Bow down to the ancient king with steel and blood!

[quote=author]■ PD Comment
You can encounter the new boss, the ‘Forgotten King’, in the new catacomb theme.Those who venture into his slumbering domain will have the chance to face this long-forgotten ancient ruler. Although our conversation may need to be conducted with steel and blood. 
We’ll continue to add exciting themes to the Witch’s Dungeon. Enjoy exploring the new areas and uncovering the hidden mechanics, and embrace the adventure![/quote]

[h3]4. Locked Treasure Chests and Keys Added[/h3]
- Explore every corner of the dungeon to find locked treasure chests! To open these chests, you’ll need a key, but if you can unlock them, you’ll be rewarded with surprising treasures.
The ‘Thief Rio’ has a special ability to open locked chests without keys, staying true to her thieving nature.

[quote=author]■ PD Comment
Locked chests naturally offer higher-quality rewards. However, Thief Rio has the unique ability to unlock chests without needing a key.
How about teaming up with the Desert Starlette today  and searching for those hidden treasures?[/quote]


[h3]5. Tutorial Added[/h3]
- A tutorial has been added to help you learn the basics of Dungeon Stalkers! Before diving into dungeon exploration, how about sharpening your skills with a thorough introduction?

[quote=author]■ PD Comment
We’ve introduced a tutorial feature. When you log in for the first time, you can choose whether to start the tutorial. Join Hilda, who finds herself in trouble during her adventure, and learn the basic  of the game’s systems and combat. You can exit the tutorial at any time and replay it as needed
We’ve meticulously prepared this tutorial to build your confidence in combat, survival, and escape, helping you become a powerful stalker. If you find the gameplay challenging, we highly recommend playing through the tutorial.[/quote]

[h3]6. Mail System and Attendance Book Added[/h3]
- We’ve added a mail system and an attendance book to enhance your gaming experience. Be sure to participate in the attendance event during the August beta test.

[quote=author]■ PD Comment
With the attendance event, you can ear Rene by participating in the test for 7 days. This reward will be bound to your account and available for future use. Be sure to participate in the test to claim your Rene![/quote]


[h2]📢 New Item & Content Reward Added[/h2]

[h3]1. New Battle Items Introduced[/h3]
- We’ve added new battle items: Gas Bomb, Freeze Bomb, Shock Flask, Holy Water Flask, Barrier Flask. Spice up your battles by utilizing these diverse items!

[quote=author]■ PD Comment
We've increased the variety of “Throwable items” significantly. While the utility of throwable items was somewhat limited in previous battles, we’ve introduced exciting new items that can dramatically alter the course of combat. These additions are designed for various scenarios, including entry, escape, and combos. We look forward to seeing your creative uses for them! [/quote]

[h3]2. New Crafting and Battlefield Exchange Exclusive Equipment [/h3]
- Collect materials to craft exclusive gear and exchange them for battlefield specific items! These special pieces of equipment might offer unique benefits.

[h3]3. Free Costume Added[/h3]
- A free costume featuring Hilda’s Legacy Body is now available!

[quote=author]■ PD Comment
We’re excited to gift you a skin featuring Hilda’s classic body shape. For those who miss the early version of hilda, this skin is a nostalgic treat. 
We want to assure you that our development team is committed to understanding our target audience and prioritizing content that meets your interests. This costume is part of our effort to gather and consider your feedback.
We welcome all your opinions and are ready to listen seriously. Your feedback is invaluable to us![/quote]


[h2]📢Changes and Updates[/h2]

[h3]1. Improved Map System[/h3]
- The map system has been enhanced for better usability. The updated region map now allows you to view the dungeon’s layout and essential location information.

[quote=author]■ PD Comment
This feature was added after much consideration. While learning the map and adapting to your surroundings is a key part of the Dungeon Stalkers experience, we wanted to ensure that enhancing convenience didn’t detract from the fun of exploring.
However, with the introduction of diverse theme like the new catacomb, and our plans to offer differentiated experiences and rewards for each theme, we wanted to avoid the frustrating experience of blindly searching for specific areas based solely on luck.
Therefore, in this version, the region map will display only the overall and minimal location information. We’re eager to hear your feedback on this system and, as with all systems and content, we’re closely monitoring your responses and opinions.[/quote]

[h3]2. Changes to Equipment System.[/h3]
The stats of existing equipment will be adjusted as follows.
[olist]
1) Armor : no longer provides defense but now has increased durability.
2) Helmets, Gloves, and Boots : Enhanced to offer higher defense than before.
3) pants : Now increase maximum health
4) Weapons : Overall stats have been adjusted, with attack power varying based on attack speed.
5) Accessories : Added a variety of accessories with different stats.
[/olist]

[h3]3. Balance Adjustments & Improvements[/h3]
[olist]
1) The movement speed reduction effect when casting skills will be slightly reduced for all Stalkers characters. Additionally, the movement speed reduction during attacks from other players will be slightly adjusted.
2) The time required to open doors has been reduced, allowing for quicker access.
3) The shield defense mechanics for Hilda and Clad have been improved.
4) Some skill effects for Stalkers characters have been adjusted.
5) Some skill detection mechanics for Stalkers have been refined.
6) Monster Aggro system improvements.
7) Monster balance adjustments and some monster skill modifications.
[/olist]
[quote=author]■ PD Comment
This version aims to maintain a more gradual balance for PVP content while creating a more enjoyable PVE environment. We want to avoid situations where players struggle excessively against a few regular monsters. We believe that fulfilling the power fantasy of being a hero is what sets Dungeon Stalkers apart from other similar games in terms of combat
We understand that some adjustments may not fully meet your expectations. However, our development team is continuously engaged in rigorous discussions to find balanced values that everyone can agree on. We welcome and encourage your feedback to help us refine the balance further.[/quote]

[h3]4. Other Convenience Feature Improvements[/h3]
Based on the feedback we received during the May test, we’ve prioritized and quickly addressed the most requested convenience features!
[olist]
1) Friendly Unit Outlines
2) Improved Buff and Debuff UI Icon
3) Auto Sorting for Storage
4) Improved Random Matchmaking Button
[/olist]

[quote=author]■ Final PD Comment
This test version has been created with the goal of improving many aspects and showcasing our vision for the future. As the evaluation of our team has become more positive, we’ve been able to invest in a longer QA schedule to enhance stability. This is all thanks to your support and interest.
We aim to continue providing you with thrilling and enjoyable experiences as you explore the mysterious and perilous dungeons of Dungeon Stalkers, escaping with incredible treasures. We hope you will walk this path with us and cheer us on.
See you in the dungeon, Stalkers.[/quote]

notes.title: Developer's Note: June Update
notes.content:
Hello, Stalkers!
First and foremost, we want to extend our sincere gratitude to everyone who participated in the surprise test last month.

While there are countless tasks to tackle, we'd like to share some of the key areas we are prioritizing and our plans for the future.

[h2][b]Validation and testing of the 
major improvement tasks from the May surprise test:[/b][/h2]

We received a diverse array of feedback on the content added during this test, exceeding our expectations. Once again, thank you for your valuable feedback.

[olist]
[*] New Player Character Summoner Rene
[*] New PvP mode Supremacy
[*] Equipment Stat Rerolling / Equipment Crafting Feature
[*] Daily Quests
[*] Addition of New Equipment slots such as necklace, ring, etc.
[*] Lobby Customization
[*] Addition of Cool Dances
[*] Improved Attack Speed
[*] Increased Frequency of Crimson Veil and Witch's Curse occurrences
[*] Changed to Allow Equipping New Armor even if the current one is destroyed
[*] Changed to allow random matchmaking for one player in 2-player parties
[*] Improvements to ranking leaderboards, etc.
[/olist]
We are currently in the process of implementing improvements based on the feedback received on the aforementioned topics. Additionally, we anticipate that you may be curious about the areas we are aiming to improve in the future.

[h2][b]Areas we are preparing to 
improve quickly after the May surprise test:[/b][/h2]
[olist]
[*] Adjusting Equipment Drop Rates
During the recent test, many players felt that the drop rate for good equipment in dungeons was too high, reducing the need for other content like crafting. We deeply understand this concern and plan to balance it so that dungeons and crafting content can coexist appropriately.

[*] New PvP Mode: Supremacy
Supremacy was the biggest addition during this test. It is still in the development stage, but it was the core content of the test. We wanted to collect and incorporate your feedback from the development stage, all the way through to the completion of the mode. Although there were some server stability issues during the test, we aim to have them ironed out in time for the next test so that we can test the fun factor and balance of the mode. 

[*] Balancing New Content and Features
There were various opinions regarding the balance of newly added features. For example, there was considerable feedback regarding adjustments to the gold cost for equipment re-rolling. We are currently working on balancing these finer details. The equipment swapping system was well received by many Stalkers, and we plan to finalize improvements to it. Additionally, we plan to implement unique attributes for each type of armor in the future.

[*] Improving Non-Intuitive Monster Patterns and Adjusting Difficulty of Some Monsters
We will adjust the balance of certain monsters like gargoyles, which received a lot of feedback regarding PVE difficulty.

[*] Expanding the Use of Acquired Resources
While playing the game, players acquire various resources. Instead of solely focusing on the goal of acquisition, we aim to constantly consider and expand the range of possibilities for how these resources can be utilized. Although this is a long-term endeavor, we plan to reflect ways to utilize leftover resources in the next test as well.

[*] Other Convenience Features and Design Improvements
We also aim to implement some convenience features and design improvements that can be quickly applied. While some improvements may require time for development, we intend to swiftly apply changes to items that received a lot of feedback. For example, a quick sort function for stash and bags and enhancing the visibility of buff and debuff icons. Additionally, there was considerable feedback regarding a training mode, which was already part of the development plan, so we aim to consider its implementation as early as the next test.

[*] Balance Adjustments and Improvements for New and Existing Characters
We will make adjustments based on feedback about the balance of the new character Rene and other Stalkers. Rene has received a lot of feedback regarding unclear hit detection and the ambiguous use of ice summons. She is a character intended to excel at PvE. We will focus on making hunting more enjoyable, and pay more attention to increasing her utility in PvP.

[*] Improving Character Animations and Hitboxes
Feedback regarding animations and hitboxes for certain characters has been noted, and we intend to make improvements based on the feedback provided for the next test. The development team will pay more attention and effort to elevate the overall quality.

[*] Game Optimization 
Game optimization is a significant task, and we are considering and applying various different methods to ensure that you can enjoy the game in the best possible way. 

[*] Other Improvements
We are gradually preparing to implement more improvements to other convenience features as well. We fully empathize with the need for a key binding system, based on the feedback from the last test, and we are currently working on its implementation. However, we feel that there are some areas that need further refinement before being fully integrated into the game for this test. Therefore, we plan to take some more time to ensure a stable introduction within the game. Additionally, we are carefully considering the implementation of other convenience features such as spectator mode and reporting functionality for disruptive users.
[/olist]
Finally, emote features, such as dances, were more well-received than anticipated. We are gradually preparing to introduce a variety of new emotes. We are also considering implementing unique emotes for each character.

Certainly, there are many details that are difficult to convey in a brief message, but many aspects will undergo changes in the upcoming tests.


[h2][b]Plans for the Next Test:[/b][/h2]
The upcoming test will be on a larger scale than the recent surprise test we conducted. Based on the feedback you provided, we will quickly improve what we can, address any shortcomings, and thoroughly prepare for the next test.

In addition to the 7 Stalkers previously introduced, we are preparing to unveil new Stalkers with various charms. We are also in the process of developing new maps with exciting environments to provide even more exhilarating gameplay. Furthermore, we are preparing new Witch's Curses and items to heighten the tension in the game, so please stay tuned.

We are also planning promotions through various media channels. We believe the next test will allow more Stalkers to experience what the dungeon has to offer. 

While the downtime between tests can be dull, we’re preparing various lore dives and stories for you to enjoy. 

Once again, we extend our deepest gratitude to all the Stalkers who participated in the test. Please continue to show interest and support for Dungeon Stalkers. We will work even harder to meet your expectations.

Stay healthy, and we look forward to seeing you in better form in the next test.

Thank you.
David

notes.title: Dungeon Stalkers 2nd Test added content & changes
notes.content:
Hello Stalkers!

The 2nd test of Dungeon Stalkers is about to begin! Those who participated in the 1st test have been eagerly wondering what changes will occur in the 2nd test. Numerous balances have been significantly altered, and many improvements based on your feedback have been implemented. Please check the list below!

[h1]Content Additions:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [h3]Solo Mode[/h3] Solo mode, accessible only for solo players and not parties, has been added. Even those playing alone can enjoy the game.
[*] [h3]Rank System[/h3] The rank system has been implemented for the first time. It displays your adventures in ranks. Climb up to the highest rank!
[*] [h3]Stalkers Costumes[/h3] Stalkers' costumes have been added. Initially, you can explore costumes with various color variations.
[*] [h3]Map Block - Goblin Mine[/h3] A Goblin Mine block is added to DS's random maps. The minerals from the Goblin Mine will be crucial items for future crafting. (Crafting is not included in this test)
[*] [h3]Witch's Curse[/h3] Five new witch's curses have been added. (We’ll keep the specifics secret for you to have fun.)
[*] [h3]Witch's Summons System[/h3] To make the time spent in the dungeon's last phase more enjoyable, the Witch's Summons have been added. During the final stage, when there aren’t many monsters or other players wandering in the dungeon, the Witch's Summons will make it more exciting. The Red Curtain (Forcefield) gathers everyone in the dungeon to impose a trial. If you survive the trial, you'll get a chance to escape. But be cautious; not everyone who gathers are allies.
[*] [h3]Ping System[/h3] The basics of ping system has been implemented. You can use ping through the middle mouse button.
[*] [h3]Location-Based Voice Chat[/h3] Voice chat has been implemented, based on location. Your voice can be heard not only by party members but also by nearby enemies in the dungeon.
[*] [h3]Stamina Introduction[/h3] The stamina system has been introduced. By pressing the Shift key, you can sprint for a short period. Unlike the 1st test where MP was consumed upon successful defense, stamina is consumed this time around.
[*] [h3]Various Monsters[/h3] With the addition of the Goblin Mine, various goblins and some other monsters have been added. Some existing monsters have also been modified to have more powerful attacks.
[*] [h3]Friend System[/h3] The friend system has been added. You can add friends or invite them to parties from the 'Dungeon' menu by clicking the friend icon.
[*] [h3]Witch's servant[/h3] Witch's servant has been added. You can make requests with gold. But if you attack it...
[/list]
[h1]Improvements:[/h1]
[list]
[*] [h3]Armor Destruction Related Improvements[/h3] When armor is destroyed, only upper body equipment is now destroyed. Other equipment, apart from the destroyed upper body gear, can be replaced at any time. The emphasis on HP has been increased.
[*] [h3]Damage Calculation Formula Modification[/h3] The damage calculation formula has been changed to address combat balance issues identified in the 1st test. Extreme damage output issues have been resolved.
[*] [h3]30 New Weapons added[/h3] 30 new weapons have been added for greater variety.
[*] [h3]Increase in Weapons and Equipment Options[/h3] For more diverse equipment, the number of options for equipment has been increased from 4 to 6.
[*] [h3]Improvement to Baran’s Grappling Hook Attack[/h3] The popular skill had issues properly pulling enemies if slightly caught. The pulling method has been improved to smoothly pull enemies.
[*] [h3]Warning Message when Entering Dungeon with Items[/h3] To prevent accidentally bringing items, if there are a certain number of items in the inventory or in the safe deposit box, a warning message will be displayed when entering the dungeon.
[*] [h3]Canceling Skill or Bow Attack[/h3] Right-clicking during a bow attack or skill casting allows cancellation.
[*] [h3]Interaction with Doors[/h3] Previously, the interaction had to be done where the door closed. Now, proper interaction with door objects is possible, reducing confusion.
[*] [h3]Ranged Attacks Possible through Iron Bars[/h3] While ranged attacks through iron bars were supported in the past, the hitbox was ambiguous. The modeling of iron bars has been modified to clearly create a space where attacks can be made.
[*] [h3]Alert when Being the Last Person in the Dungeon[/h3] An alert is displayed when you become the last party or person in the dungeon.
[*] [h3]Mission Item Acquisition for All Party Members Simultaneously[/h3] When completing a mission, everyone can now acquire the item instead of just one person. We will monitor gamers' reactions during this test.
[*] [h3]Added basic storage capacity increase and expansion feature[/h3] You can now expand your storage using gold.
[*] [h3]Fixed an issue where character corpses disappeared[/h3]  Addressed the problem of defeated characters from other players not disappearing.
[/list]

notes.title: What happens when your armor breaks?
notes.content:
Armor in "Dungeon Stalkers" serve as an additional barrier that protects you.

"Dungeon Stalkers" introduces two types of hit points for your character's survival.
There are "AP," or Armor Points, and "HP," which represents the health of your character.
As long as your armor remains intact, your character remains unharmed.
However, once your armor breaks, DEF falls to 0,
leaving your character vulnerable to enemy attacks!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/2e773f4a92c79c68f0b6f4d0d430a1d3fe789409.gif[/img]

While HP can be restored with potions, AP cannot be repaired within the dungeon!
(* There is one method for repairing armor, but that will be explained at another time!)

With broken armor, even a veteran dungeon explorer must stay vigilant,
as the loss of armor nullifies all its benefits.
But what if you spot another player with broken armor?
That will be the ideal opportunity to strike and seize their spoils.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/d3545761804a43ed06d7c9de1638b1f1334334df.png[/img]
In "Dungeon Stalkers", armor durability is displayed in real-time.
The visual status of your armor is presented in three stages: 100%, 50%, and 0%.
Real-time reflected armor durability allows you, your party, and your enemies to assess each other's armor status.

Also, there is no need to worry of getting another armor even if it breaks, as it will be fully repaired upon leaving the dungeon!
Your only task is to embark on an enjoyable exploration of dungeons!

notes.title: What happens in the dungeon?
notes.content:
Welcome to the witch’s dungeon!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44249378/94fabc7646136c4083025df7a7adb4c011fa2253.png[/img]

The witch’s dungeon is everchanging.
The random structure and placements will give the players a new feeling each run and
make players change their strategy in response to the randomly placed monsters.
The everchanging dungeon will feel refreshing to the gamers.

Also, the ‘Witch’s Curse’ changes the rules of the dungeon.
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYmFhMTFlZHZma3AzeXBvbnphZjlsb3JiZDlrbHE1NnBqM3A2YmVseSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/5r9MZpQxoTt6EjXpbf/giphy.gif[/img]

The ‘Witch’s Curse’ is a curse that all stalkers in the dungeon are cast under and varies from simple curses to drastic ones.

[i]Player hits are instant kills.
A powerful monster spawns nearby.
All the light in the dungeon is extinguished.
All player locations are revealed.
All monsters are weakened. (or strengthened.)[/i]

Just looking at these different curses shows the witch’s mischievousness, doesn’t it?
Survive against dangerous monsters and other stalkers with your trustworthy teammates and escape the dungeon under the witch’s curse!

notes.title: New Steam dungeon crawler fills a Dark and Darker shaped hole
notes.content:
Dungeon crawlers often feel like a struggle against the murky depths, but in Dungeon Stalkers darkness is your ally. This new RPG game on Steam blends classic fantasy style with a witchy twist, and you'll need to stay in the shadows to overcome the nightmarish hordes buried in the depths below. With the popularity of such PvEvP loot games as Dark and Darker on Steam, there's clearly an appetite here, and Dungeon Stalkers is promising quite the meal.

Read the rest of the story...
